I wanted to share these special moments with you

| [](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=799dbe2d372044a89fa010c7fc4b03d3&_e=Bmr1vemJUwuI7ihL21ztK_ORGVAuujhawE2AygZ3gPsOR7D2t069Jj1_wOqrHuFlHKoEU_i9sNzeoqgTfpQqDd0QYtsjRokeB6GMuln6IDfjx2juOuUSsUVH83xbnO_Mq-Ewh9l2BL-AyFnDWrc8WBpTT-ALadGFGxNlurGgiShvKmGErWc4jcMy91tO_RMVrZ_trpMtTN14GZd9_pLJM9isjMVVV1G0QQb1g7-lDJHgHOb7hfuNgOEleB9J6Je_uvqj8k101A2IhTa8M-4b8k0ME4nCQMQ87VcEb6v66GpOHTH1FTJJTVSTavLcdqk_HI1_AJScASIVdFEHhDCAEA6i9btBAHrvPtpZO4NeQTGN0f6rp1hYke8KJJlT9f5kRJUZktmulPyxCMjKVtuS81ljT-9z60AeE5EnIM7Yr8DMDM14VNgNH4JJ0LCjsTW4ZHwrvtK5dcbTTRe3iWJWf0OwWuaerJS9t1OGFHXgvkw%3D)

Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley, and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington, where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work. [](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=799dbe2d372044a89fa010c7fc4b03d3&_e=Bmr1vemJUwuI7ihL21ztK_ORGVAuujhawE2AygZ3gPsOR7D2t069Jj1_wOqrHuFlHKoEU_i9sNzeoqgTfpQqDd0QYtsjRokeB6GMuln6IDfjx2juOuUSsUVH83xbnO_Mq-Ewh9l2BL-AyFnDWrc8WBpTT-ALadGFGxNlurGgiShvKmGErWc4jcMy91tO_RMVrZ_trpMtTN14GZd9_pLJM9isjMVVV1G0QQb1g7-lDJHgHOb7hfuNgOEleB9J6Je_uvqj8k101A2IhTa8M-4b8k0ME4nCQMQ87VcEb6v66GpOHTH1FTJJTVSTavLcdqk_HI1_AJScASIVdFEHhDCAEII4taS756MGr3Z4TaaFZBxTz74A2PXZCwKyUzSEfLqHg0yPD1fMMUR0Z_JlNXJBBxqT8swIq19GswZG5-OGRFEPyVFNzXlTjLmmrkcfXqbsZYtSf4rA3ryIqdDKZ2kxw4GiIsptfXtqgaWJY-4c-F8%3D)
I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion for helping others in need.

[](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=799dbe2d372044a89fa010c7fc4b03d3&_e=Bmr1vemJUwuI7ihL21ztK_ORGVAuujhawE2AygZ3gPsOR7D2t069Jj1_wOqrHuFlHKoEU_i9sNzeoqgTfpQqDd0QYtsjRokeB6GMuln6IDfjx2juOuUSsUVH83xbnO_Mq-Ewh9l2BL-AyFnDWrc8WBpTT-ALadGFGxNlurGgiShvKmGErWc4jcMy91tO_RMVrZ_trpMtTN14GZd9_pLJM9isjMVVV1G0QQb1g7-lDJHgHOb7hfuNgOEleB9J6Je_uvqj8k101A2IhTa8M-4b8k0ME4nCQMQ87VcEb6v66GpOHTH1FTJJTVSTavLcdqk_HI1_AJScASIVdFEHhDCAEK4UbzgWDJgJ2pSa1ELqisCvaQiJl9iULHVHPGvXerMa9wPwnA79rsIB_Tbds8rE9IxBJis3kAOHI7vvSmloMGZBG4OB87p6BCqzmg7uAtPeTc9M7r4o6G1CYHjtSHL2pcjfWgr5BIL2vsoJPKhrb4s%3D)
I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

[](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=799dbe2d372044a89fa010c7fc4b03d3&_e=Bmr1vemJUwuI7ihL21ztK_ORGVAuujhawE2AygZ3gPsOR7D2t069Jj1_wOqrHuFlHKoEU_i9sNzeoqgTfpQqDd0QYtsjRokeB6GMuln6IDfjx2juOuUSsUVH83xbnO_Mq-Ewh9l2BL-AyFnDWrc8WBpTT-ALadGFGxNlurGgiShvKmGErWc4jcMy91tO_RMVrZ_trpMtTN14GZd9_pLJM9isjMVVV1G0QQb1g7-lDJHgHOb7hfuNgOEleB9J6Je_uvqj8k101A2IhTa8M-4b8k0ME4nCQMQ87VcEb6v66GpOHTH1FTJJTVSTavLcdqk_HI1_AJScASIVdFEHhDCAENju4iWbHAj3WutwK6Z6tKtJhWn3Ho5TJq6lOwi3YMMUOsZpKf34lSjunUGno5elY5eYbQ6SDQ3dqMAtJob7mBG-nC7GBhnhD4A17ZZVm1iCJ3M6rYzdWb_GbBROlEZ1MVlVDbbygqSKomVG-5xzD9U%3D)
In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever. Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

[](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=799dbe2d372044a89fa010c7fc4b03d3&_e=Bmr1vemJUwuI7ihL21ztK_ORGVAuujhawE2AygZ3gPsOR7D2t069Jj1_wOqrHuFlHKoEU_i9sNzeoqgTfpQqDd0QYtsjRokeB6GMuln6IDfjx2juOuUSsUVH83xbnO_Mq-Ewh9l2BL-AyFnDWrc8WBpTT-ALadGFGxNlurGgiShvKmGErWc4jcMy91tO_RMVrZ_trpMtTN14GZd9_pLJM9isjMVVV1G0QQb1g7-lDJHgHOb7hfuNgOEleB9J6Je_uvqj8k101A2IhTa8M-4b8k0ME4nCQMQ87VcEb6v66GpOHTH1FTJJTVSTavLcdqk_HI1_AJScASIVdFEHhDCAEH3fbFX4Y4L0YR509Xi3QSTk3EfbZ0TVcLMnPG_mOYDTU5j7V8Hdu8J-v5V_uTMQz0G29beilq_lJgRmlKOzSlHkBg8XmQijIcTf6lYFgxtYZRqlibOTE9uLPMRSFdXH-Q-Ewz9d7HjvxCGeTvqxrxs%3D)
When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.

_**I refused.**_
Since that day, I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran, gets the benefits and care they earned.
[](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=799dbe2d372044a89fa010c7fc4b03d3&_e=Bmr1vemJUwuI7ihL21ztK_ORGVAuujhawE2AygZ3gPsOR7D2t069Jj1_wOqrHuFlHKoEU_i9sNzeoqgTfpQqDd0QYtsjRokeB6GMuln6IDfjx2juOuUSsUVH83xbnO_Mq-Ewh9l2BL-AyFnDWrc8WBpTT-ALadGFGxNlurGgiShvKmGErWc4jcMy91tO_RMVrZ_trpMtTN14GZd9_pLJM9isjMVVV1G0QQb1g7-lDJHgHOb7hfuNgOEleB9J6Je_uvqj8k101A2IhTa8M-4b8k0ME4nCQMQ87VcEb6v66GpOHTH1FTJJTVSTavLcdqk_HI1_AJScASIVdFEHhDCAEGo5eoqkegslsZ3xtlIaWiYsBSfHwDV3eYIOiwG7Z9Oo1M4LAN8fWAkiTo9CLL2iGDzzBFVFSe02oXF-m96C36v-wUNjCJoyVBMEHkREDhDfdAeRQHz4V9FzzRE_-yl2ExA3soOunS1rqUSsVL7Y8Nc%3D)
Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

[](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=799dbe2d372044a89fa010c7fc4b03d3&_e=Bmr1vemJUwuI7ihL21ztK_ORGVAuujhawE2AygZ3gPsOR7D2t069Jj1_wOqrHuFlHKoEU_i9sNzeoqgTfpQqDd0QYtsjRokeB6GMuln6IDfjx2juOuUSsUVH83xbnO_Mq-Ewh9l2BL-AyFnDWrc8WBpTT-ALadGFGxNlurGgiShvKmGErWc4jcMy91tO_RMVrZ_trpMtTN14GZd9_pLJM9isjMVVV1G0QQb1g7-lDJHgHOb7hfuNgOEleB9J6Je_uvqj8k101A2IhTa8M-4b8k0ME4nCQMQ87VcEb6v66GpOHTH1FTJJTVSTavLcdqk_HI1_AJScASIVdFEHhDCAEJnYR5GWxwWWsH-s-BQrWJeUpZFrotl6AMOMSRepxUbm4-cub52m0OWy0HVHOhahz2g0tt_nvvdr7jkfLDje6PwEEhiVDQmrGLhUvkDCBdUxr49R0DROlYpaRkqxlF95J-opYCcwdlixdfCycos5LDk%3D)
It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--and won.

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

[](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=799dbe2d372044a89fa010c7fc4b03d3&_e=Bmr1vemJUwuI7ihL21ztK_ORGVAuujhawE2AygZ3gPsOR7D2t069Jj1_wOqrHuFlHKoEU_i9sNzeoqgTfpQqDd0QYtsjRokeB6GMuln6IDfjx2juOuUSsUVH83xbnO_Mq-Ewh9l2BL-AyFnDWrc8WBpTT-ALadGFGxNlurGgiShvKmGErWc4jcMy91tO_RMVrZ_trpMtTN14GZd9_pLJM9isjMVVV1G0QQb1g7-lDJHgHOb7hfuNgOEleB9J6Je_uvqj8k101A2IhTa8M-4b8k0ME4nCQMQ87VcEb6v66GpOHTH1FTJJTVSTavLcdqk_HI1_AJScASIVdFEHhDCAEDKAD71que6GRyzDvie-i69UC3MaVhEpPz6SNjUWzWnrugnYIWDDBR9U97fGPRbQ3oVyvphP2ZLTTdAwsNvZZliDHFSKHfd08cUT6AbnMXIzZyRH2DnBpzSUQAf04wpPbZkJ3OXyh2XiyeTVaiSQHwk%3D)
In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

[](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=799dbe2d372044a89fa010c7fc4b03d3&_e=Bmr1vemJUwuI7ihL21ztK_ORGVAuujhawE2AygZ3gPsOR7D2t069Jj1_wOqrHuFlHKoEU_i9sNzeoqgTfpQqDd0QYtsjRokeB6GMuln6IDfjx2juOuUSsUVH83xbnO_Mq-Ewh9l2BL-AyFnDWrc8WBpTT-ALadGFGxNlurGgiShvKmGErWc4jcMy91tO_RMVrZ_trpMtTN14GZd9_pLJM9isjMVVV1G0QQb1g7-lDJHgHOb7hfuNgOEleB9J6Je_uvqj8k101A2IhTa8M-4b8k0ME4nCQMQ87VcEb6v66GpOHTH1FTJJTVSTavLcdqk_HI1_AJScASIVdFEHhDCAEOSfIj3OiVCAgJFlUh9qtWlb_VJplrLQqFbfPxC6J1WOqEyiuwSIVBPsS3CrdmR-8lHwRZ_btgfuWBZ1pLUHk5HaNGFn9mFRbsXX7d_MII9CZuUHuIIexJLD_76BEJFvp2s7LW631dNPWpGVErtwcBE%3D)
Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

[](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=799dbe2d372044a89fa010c7fc4b03d3&_e=Bmr1vemJUwuI7ihL21ztK_ORGVAuujhawE2AygZ3gPsOR7D2t069Jj1_wOqrHuFlHKoEU_i9sNzeoqgTfpQqDd0QYtsjRokeB6GMuln6IDfjx2juOuUSsUVH83xbnO_Mq-Ewh9l2BL-AyFnDWrc8WBpTT-ALadGFGxNlurGgiShvKmGErWc4jcMy91tO_RMVrZ_trpMtTN14GZd9_pLJM9isjMVVV1G0QQb1g7-lDJHgHOb7hfuNgOEleB9J6Je_uvqj8k101A2IhTa8M-4b8k0ME4nCQMQ87VcEb6v66GpOHTH1FTJJTVSTavLcdqk_HI1_AJScASIVdFEHhDCAEAKjvsaFp9gqBQ-6QAgGuvmx-t0Eo9bFhI9kAdbJPH7FqXCAFRtJTGDd2ilUM0bM-XbMix7f9Vv2TRdhqqJBVyUKVtZDkmzLmjmrsVfT8RP4_vO01Sjz5pOpS5edXpjUkypzt1uPH6t4vxVWVivJ41o%3D)
My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed, and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capital.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, Peter. [**So please -- can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far?**](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=799dbe2d372044a89fa010c7fc4b03d3&_e=Bmr1vemJUwuI7ihL21ztK_ORGVAuujhawE2AygZ3gPsOR7D2t069Jj1_wOqrHuFlHKoEU_i9sNzeoqgTfpQqDd0QYtsjRokeB6GMuln6IDfjx2juOuUSsUVH83xbnO_Mq-Ewh9l2BL-AyFnDWrc8WBpTT-ALadGFGxNlurGgiShvKmGErWc4jcMy91tO_RMVrZ_trpMtTN14GZd9_pLJM9isjMVVV1G0QQb1g7-lDJHgHOb7hfuNgOEleB9J6Je_uvqj8k101A2IhTa8M-4b8k0ME4nCQMQ87VcEb6v66GpOHTH1FTJJTVSTavLcdqk_HI1_AJScASIVdFEHhDCAEHYgz4mKjpuwYtunWClM9ORen4R6IpkFzDqIj14pAvDv-JRxKz56JyVGBlv35Btwl_7x1Jt3j3mTpPoaSUBIFSKdbNlBo1FAH2MDlClSh5lKo456tr5FbbqyiJ219CPnrWgLJz5cAmP539zY0D4dCFw%3D) | [**KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT**](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=799dbe2d372044a89fa010c7fc4b03d3&_e=Bmr1vemJUwuI7ihL21ztK_ORGVAuujhawE2AygZ3gPsOR7D2t069Jj1_wOqrHuFlHKoEU_i9sNzeoqgTfpQqDd0QYtsjRokeB6GMuln6IDfjx2juOuUSsUVH83xbnO_Mq-Ewh9l2BL-AyFnDWrc8WBpTT-ALadGFGxNlurGgiShvKmGErWc4jcMy91tO_RMVrZ_trpMtTN14GZd9_pLJM9isjMVVV1G0QQb1g7-lDJHgHOb7hfuNgOEleB9J6Je_uvqj8k101A2IhTa8M-4b8k0ME4nCQMQ87VcEb6v66GpOHTH1FTJJTVSTavLcdqk_HI1_AJScASIVdFEHhDCAEAtf8iwmkD9vF69bpYywQOBuMF3Zl_MQBVtyK8qMubnzsR0ectLhG1lDCO79k4Z0hp4Wb8O67X5CnCjakyVdtCA5RzRql8RNa92N4It4jkjQReyWvrIU4e67InybQGLDIK4xF9fWMd5jFn7L8CQlksg%3D)

Listen, we’re almost at the finish line.

| Hey , Peter did you see Sara’s message from earlier today?

| | 2023 NEGOP LEGISLATIVE PLAN FOR NEBRASKA"PROVIDE SAFE COMMUNITIES SO FAMILIES CAN LIVE IN PEACE"
---
| | Nebraskans deserve a better and brighter future. They desire policies that put them first instead of policies that stand in their way. The Nebraska Republican Party supports a legislative plan building a path for a brighter tomorrow. We have full confidence in the potential of Nebraskans to create a future for themselves and their families filled with peace, prosperity, and opportunity. Below is one of the areas our 2023 Legislative Plan focuses on. [PROVIDE SAFE COMMUNITIES SO FAMILIES CAN LIVE IN PEACE](https://www.ne.gop/so/2fOGujyz5/c?w=KmEiQEv1QQsoAC39u4u8QI-NsAXmzxdouN_953SYRLE.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubmUuZ29wLzIwMjNsZWdpc2xhdGl2ZXBsYW4iLCJyIjoiYTA3NTZiNjYtMmNhYy00ZjlkLTgwMzQtYTRkODE4YzY0NGFiIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiNDE4YzE3NjEtZWRkMy00YzFhLWIwNjQtYzBiYWM5ZDAyNjRmIn0) The rule of law is indispensable to our great state. However, it is impossible for Nebraskans to be safe and secure with the increasing rate of violent crime in our state. State and local governments must meet their basic duty of providing public safety, ensuring that every Nebraskan enjoys a safe and secure community.
* Promote respect for law enforcement and provide necessary public safety funding
* Unravel organized crime, human trafficking, and the drug trade within our state
* Address poverty and mental health issues that are impacting our urban and rural areas

We believe the rights of society and the rights of the individual are both important and must be protected. We support, uphold and promote public respect for the Law and all Law Enforcement Officers. We strongly support our Nebraska Law Enforcement Officers, First Responders and formally extend our gratitude for the invaluable job of keeping our neighborhoods safe. The widespread abuse of drugs and the immoderate use of alcohol are threats to all members of society, especially our children. We urge strict enforcement of laws to control and punish those who deal in illegal drugs. We oppose the legalization of marijuana and other controlled substances. We recognize the need to increase the availability of drug and alcohol prevention and rehabilitation. We support, welcome, and encourage the assimilation of all legal immigrants and others who are here pursuant to due process and are productive, law-abiding citizens. In fairness to them, we support stringent federal efforts to stem the tide of illegal immigration. We oppose sanctuary status for cities or other government entities and call state officials to collaborate on the enforcement of existing immigration laws.
---
| | When our communities are safe, our families are safe and able to thrive. Nebraska Republicans stand for "Law and Order". Those who serve and sacrifice deserve our honor, respect, and backing. My opponent released an internal poll showing him _UP ONE POINT._ [**I need you and 50 of my top supporters to rush in $25 in the next 30 minutes to help me prove our support is stronger than ever in this Utah Senate race.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61786352:6tTJYTGNu:m:1:3317145305:CC9034414EAE0ED54E9BB5FF6EF2EB85:r)

This poll might've been conducted by a Democrat firm who worked for Barack Obama, Hillary Clinton, and Joe Biden - but we can't take anything for granted.

**_This race is too important to sit on the sidelines and let my opponent claim he 's leading._**

Please, I need to hear from you and 50 of my other top supporters in order to keep our momentum strong and win this race. [**I 'm counting on hearing from you in the next 30 minutes.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61786352:6tTJYTGNu:m:1:3317145305:CC9034414EAE0ED54E9BB5FF6EF2EB85:r)

For America,
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61786353:6tTJYTGNu:m:1:3317145305:CC9034414EAE0ED54E9BB5FF6EF2EB85:r)
Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Peter - We're coming down to the wire now.

With just 5 days to go until Election Day, we continue to crisscross the state on our Unite Georgia bus tour. Senator Ted Cruz recently joined us for a few stops, so I want to share a video he and I recorded for YOU.

**[MESSAGE FROM SENATOR TED CRUZ:](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61786362:61FtYTGBN:m:1:3331703221:975822F4408ADB6811D63843E67FD0AA:r)**

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61786362:61FtYTGBN:m:1:3331703221:975822F4408ADB6811D63843E67FD0AA:r)

Hey Team,
Growing up, I was lucky enough to have leaders to look up to. Leaders who exemplified values and ideas like courage, wisdom, and compassion. Watching and listening to them inspired me, and helped instill those same values in me. When I look at Jim Jordan I see the opposite of those values, and it terrifies me to imagine little boys and girls being shaped by his hatred, extremism, and lies. If Jim Jordan gets elected as Speaker, he won’t just shape our nation’s policy, he’ll be shaping the next generation of leaders in America. Do you really want your children to be shaped by a guy who refuses to stand up for survivors of CHILD RAPE, SEX ABUSE, and the CONSTITUTION of the UNITED STATES?
We need better leaders in Washington not just for us, but for our kids and the young people in our lives that we love and care about. As a single mother, I am ALWAYS conscious of the example I set for my son. As your Congresswoman, I promise to always be aware of how I am representing our district, our state, and influencing our children. [View this message in your browser](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z76m77kssf122pe0dci61dc23ng9k01h5jjhue70_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5hm9pr1clh238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij78bielqr0sbiegqb7ctl6tr779hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4oni66pbcsdgepq71ddhmop72c70s5h74opn64om2c76c1oe5chhmtirfc35e4qr1puie1p64pjgm9j71p5jcdjr4tr66lgbbd70e9q6ccdgm9j61o5lcdge1d9h66qj3dbi4no)
This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zq0u6o17oec1dbd78iqvg1i7leved41jvs34472g_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5hm9pr1clh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2t6sa05i9s8hja1aa1u8troagajcflujted0v38_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5hm9pr1clh2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zb28b8fgqh655fbq5num6k7jrdhuosc2obcit1tg_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5hm9pr1clh2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Fellow Patriot, [**I urge you, right this second, to sign the National Petition for an Article V Convention of States to save America**.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z0ar97cfvtchmshtu4nq2taa8kacvq47et1cb9vg_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5hm9pr0c1h2bs) An army of conservative heroes including **_Mark Levin, Ben Shapiro, Sean Hannity,_** and** _Lt. Col. Allen West_** have joined our movement to call for an Article V Convention of States. [**Just click here to add your name to this national petition. And then PLEASE forward this email to every single person you know.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2za33ah1q48h4h6jkbg87psfvcmtj0jp4av8lnf6o_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5hm9pr0c1h2bs)
---
[**Sign The Petition**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zf252s9k9l519baqd0hjc4af8u2dr1rlmg7kukvg_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5hm9pr0c1h2bs)
---
Our nation is spiraling out of control. Debt threatens to cripple our economy. Federal spending has never been higher -- nor has our deficit. And the politicians in Washington won't do anything to save us. _In fact, most of them are part of the problem!_ A Convention of States is our only hope. You see, our Founding Fathers were brilliant men. They left an emergency clause in the Constitution in case the federal government got too big and out-of-control. **Article V of the Constitution allows the states to bypass Congress and the President to call a Convention of States to propose amendments to our Constitution that will rein in the federal government.** Well, conservative leaders all across the country -- along with over **_FIVE MILLION_** grassroots patriots -- believe it is time to invoke Article V and call a Convention of States for the express, _limited_ purpose of imposing fiscal restraints and term limits on Congress and limiting the power, scope, and jurisdiction of the federal government. And I hope you do, too. With the socialists in control in Washington, it's time to take action before it's too late! It's time for "We the People" to use the most powerful weapon in our arsenal - the Constitution - to fight back against Washington's overreach. [**Please sign the National Petition for an Article V Convention of States right now, and please ask everyone you know to do the same.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z596vqtumfvmpbh27mml2loss7hd4fktq0dsnn4o_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5hm9pr0c1h2bs) Here at Convention of States Action, we are working overtime to convince the required 34 state legislatures to call for an Article V convention to place limits on the power and jurisdiction of the federal government. **We have already passed the COS Resolution through the state legislatures in 19 states, including four since the start of this year alone -- bringing us over __HALFWAY__ to calling a Convention of States and taking the power back from the "ruling class" in Washington!** This year alone, the Resolution has passed out of committee in Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Iowa, and Kansas -- paving the way for the next round of states to pass! With dozens of states currently considering the COS Resolution, _NOW_ is our window of opportunity to double down and secure the needed victories to cross the finish line! We have a citizen activist army operating in all 50 states, working tirelessly to urge their state legislators to act in accordance with the will of the people and demand that they pass this critically important Resolution. **A Convention of States is our only chance to pass important and long overdue measures like a balanced budget amendment, term limits on Congress and the D.C. Swamp, and limits on the scope and jurisdiction of the federal government.** The politicians in Washington wouldn't dare limit their own power. Therefore, we the people need to do it! But in order for that to happen, we need millions and millions of patriotic Americans like you to sign this important national petition. We need to show the members of the state legislatures that the American people are ready for a constitutional solution as big as our nation's problems, an Article V Convention of States. [**Simply click here to sign and we’ll deliver it directly to your state legislators, free of charge. This is our best chance to save America from an out-of-control federal government.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zd0lb3cdg6ho3geh5depq8ea16ojq3pe9pfqfv1g_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5hm9pr0c1h2bs) Washington won't fix itself. The federal government is too big, and the politicians are too invested in its growth. We the people must take control through our state legislatures. [**Please join the fight to call a Convention of States. Sign the petition today, and urge every freedom-loving American to do the same.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z544hj0u6alhe7b4atu7fsbmie5is8nji6qut690_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5hm9pr0c1h2bs)

---
Thank you, and may God bless America! For America, Mark Meckler President Convention of States Action

body:
I urge you, right this second, to sign the National Petition for an Article V Convention of States to save America.
| | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zkf80r9748rrjdkmhampd1ef2st4rsbm7c08j3qo_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5jm8ob4clh2bs)

Fellow Patriot, [**I urge you, right this second, to sign the National Petition for an Article V Convention of States to save America**.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zot9j13s9k0t9ecjr8envqqce8qoh0uubh10ulqo_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5jm8ob4clh2bs) An army of conservative heroes including **_Mark Levin, Ben Shapiro, Sean Hannity,_** and** _Lt. Col. Allen West_** have joined our movement to call for an Article V Convention of States. [**Just click here to add your name to this national petition. And then PLEASE forward this email to every single person you know.**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zr0rqt8mpa35miceocrjc622g22et3e8j6f417t0_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5jm8ob4clh2bs)
---
[**Sign The Petition**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zpriec0uha68hrkmjch8o1aka93ccapkhag8t17o_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5jm8ob4clh2bs)
---
Our nation is spiraling out of control. Debt threatens to cripple our economy. Federal spending has never been higher -- nor has our deficit. And the politicians in Washington won't do anything to save us. _In fact, most of them are part of the problem!_ A Convention of States is our only hope. You see, our Founding Fathers were brilliant men. They left an emergency clause in the Constitution in case the federal government got too big and out-of-control. **Article V of the Constitution allows the states to bypass Congress and the President to call a Convention of States to propose amendments to our Constitution that will rein in the federal government.** Well, conservative leaders all across the country -- along with over **_FIVE MILLION_** grassroots patriots -- believe it is time to invoke Article V and call a Convention of States for the express, _limited_ purpose of imposing fiscal restraints and term limits on Congress and limiting the power, scope, and jurisdiction of the federal government. And I hope you do, too. With the socialists in control in Washington, it's time to take action before it's too late! It's time for "We the People" to use the most powerful weapon in our arsenal - the Constitution - to fight back against Washington's overreach. [**Please sign the National Petition for an Article V Convention of States right now, and please ask everyone you know to do the same.**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z8hgbln8cuiod6ju5vg55ef83uqprisvm1rg2bjo_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5jm8ob4clh2bs) Here at Convention of States Action, we are working overtime to convince the required 34 state legislatures to call for an Article V convention to place limits on the power and jurisdiction of the federal government. **We have already passed the COS Resolution through the state legislatures in 19 states, including four since the start of this year alone -- bringing us over __HALFWAY__ to calling a Convention of States and taking the power back from the "ruling class" in Washington!** This year alone, the Resolution has passed out of committee in Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Iowa, and Kansas -- paving the way for the next round of states to pass! With dozens of states currently considering the COS Resolution, _NOW_ is our window of opportunity to double down and secure the needed victories to cross the finish line! We have a citizen activist army operating in all 50 states, working tirelessly to urge their state legislators to act in accordance with the will of the people and demand that they pass this critically important Resolution. **A Convention of States is our only chance to pass important and long overdue measures like a balanced budget amendment, term limits on Congress and the D.C. Swamp, and limits on the scope and jurisdiction of the federal government.** The politicians in Washington wouldn't dare limit their own power. Therefore, we the people need to do it! But in order for that to happen, we need millions and millions of patriotic Americans like you to sign this important national petition. We need to show the members of the state legislatures that the American people are ready for a constitutional solution as big as our nation's problems, an Article V Convention of States. [**Simply click here to sign and we’ll deliver it directly to your state legislators, free of charge. This is our best chance to save America from an out-of-control federal government.**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z5ll42omjpe6ed4ogsq6180aah5cdbq43ali1sro_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5jm8ob4clh2bs) Washington won't fix itself. The federal government is too big, and the politicians are too invested in its growth. We the people must take control through our state legislatures. [**Please join the fight to call a Convention of States. Sign the petition today, and urge every freedom-loving American to do the same.**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zql6lmcuur0etvtbqhsokparveojoamfi6tkgqd0_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5jm8ob4clh2bs)

Thank you, and may God bless America! For America, Mark Meckler President Convention of States Action

Well, conservative leaders all across the country -- along with over FIVE MILLION grassroots patriots -- believe it is time to invoke Article V and call a Convention of States for the express, limited purpose of imposing fiscal restraints and term limits on Congress and limiting the power, scope, and jurisdiction of the federal government. And I hope you do, too. With the socialists in control in Washington, it's time to take action before it's too late! It's time for "We the People" to use the most powerful weapon in our arsenal - the Constitution - to fight back against Washington's overreach. Here at Convention of States Action, we are working overtime to convince the required 34 state legislatures to call for an Article V convention to place limits on the power and jurisdiction of the federal government. We have already passed the COS Resolution through the state legislatures in 19 states, including four since the start of this year alone -- bringing us over HALFWAY to calling a Convention of States and taking the power back from the "ruling class" in Washington! This year alone, the Resolution has passed out of committee in Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Iowa, and Kansas -- paving the way for the next round of states to pass! With dozens of states currently considering the COS Resolution, NOW is our window of opportunity to double down and secure the needed victories to cross the finish line! We have a citizen activist army operating in all 50 states, working tirelessly to urge their state legislators to act in accordance with the will of the people and demand that they pass this critically important Resolution. A Convention of States is our only chance to pass important and long overdue measures like a balanced budget amendment, term limits on Congress and the D.C. Swamp, and limits on the scope and jurisdiction of the federal government. The politicians in Washington wouldn't dare limit their own power. Therefore, we the people need to do it! But in order for that to happen, we need millions and millions of patriotic Americans like you to sign this important national petition. We need to show the members of the state legislatures that the American people are ready for a constitutional solution as big as our nation's problems, an Article V Convention of States. Washington won't fix itself. The federal government is too big, and the politicians are too invested in its growth. We the people must take control through our state legislatures. Thank you, and may God bless America! subject: Uniting police with Black communities
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61788605:JJ0TVTGWN:m:1:3374012347:46490462511FCFE32BDADED11D6192B7:r)

Hello Peter,

The Left wants the next generation of Black Americans to self-destruct. They have set out to destroy our families, defund the police, and leave our communities vulnerable.

And if the Left succeeds, the next generation will have no family to support them and become victims of crime in their own neighborhoods.

I saw a video of a group of Black teens DESTROYING a local store in their own community. This was where their parents and grandparents shopped, and these children destroyed it for no reason -- _**just because they were bored.**_

My name is Brandom Tatum, an ex-police officer and co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation.

**BLEXIT is extending an opportunity for you to get involved and empower Black communities by opening pro-police dialogues.**

Peter, I've set a goal to raise $24,000 in the next 48 hours to support our work to build strong communities and stop the over-incarceration of minorities among the next generation.

[_**Can you join us in our mission by sending a gift of $25, $35, $50, or any amount? Click here to send your gift >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61788605:JJ0TVTGWN:m:1:3374012347:46490462511FCFE32BDADED11D6192B7:r)

The only limits we face come from the person in the mirror.
* Not from our skin color.
* Not from where we grow up.
* Not from a broken family.

This is a deeply personal topic to me. I served in the Tucson Police Department as a SWAT operator, field training officer, general instructor, and Public Information Officer.

**I know how important it is to create relationships between police officers and these communities.**

Black communities must end the victimhood mentality that the media and other organizations force on us. It's why BLEXIT stresses the importance of education, family, the presence of a father in the home, and the support of a strong community to _**avoid**_ incarceration.

name: Rep. Dana Criswell
subject: $250 million in 5 hours
body:
Yesterday, in less than 5 hours with little to no debate, the Mississippi legislature gave away $250 million of your money to an undisclosed company. This project uses millions of tax payer dollars,
|
---
| | | | Yesterday, in less than 5 hours with little to no debate, the Mississippi legislature gave away $250 million of your money to an undisclosed company. This project uses millions of tax payer dollars, including cash and compensation to the company , a 15-year exemption of corporate income taxes, and exemption from sales and use taxes. It pays the company back 3.5% of the gross payroll for 10 years and it allows the company to pay for employees’ moving expenses from other states.This is not acceptable to business owners and job creators in Mississippi who do not benefit from any of these carve-outs. Republicans claim during elections that small businesses are the engine that drives our economy, but their actions are always in favor of the large corporations. Mississippi has been giving money away for "economic development" since 1936 and we are still in last place economically. We must stop corporate welfare and focus on real economic growth. If we focused on building a climate that businesses wanted, we would not have to bribe them with taxpayers' hard-earned money.Corporate welfare is not good for the taxpayers but is part of the “good ole boys’” system that makes so many people distrust government.I am proud to say that the Mississippi Freedom Caucus stood fast against the establishment and voted in support of Mississippi's small business owners and taxpayers. With your help, thousands of emails were sent to the Governor and legislators opposing, behind the scenes, backdoor give-away deals. [One reporter,](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/mKL0EU4OSsgyPMEi4O9z7w) while covering the special session, called us the**“small but vocal Mississippi Freedom Caucus of conservative Republican lawmakers.” ** Our voice is only made loud because of you, our supporters. We may not have won the war, but they know we are in the battle.Thank you for fighting with us,Dana

Hi Derek, I’m Dr. Steve Shapiro — Josh’s dad. We're in the home stretch of this race, so I wanted to reach out and tell you why I’m so proud of Josh, but first I have to ask: **[We’re just five days out, can you donate a few bucks to my son’s campaign?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53934529/376942333/1441362397?refcode=email_110322_5daysdrsteve_allsuper&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=ac30c89e-7b5b-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzMwYzg5ZS03YjViLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=p_gzNCLPpQxwTo9-xydnKR4iZntYa8NNUz0Fkpe6HF8=)** I’ve seen the impact Josh has had since he entered public service and became Attorney General — especially how he handled the opioid crisis. I’m a doctor, and I’m proud that my son took the lead in the courts against the big pharmaceutical companies responsible for excessive opioid distribution throughout Pennsylvania and across the country. The settlement will provide funds for necessary opioid treatment for those in distress in every county in the Commonwealth. All of that was accomplished while he continued to protect health care for millions of Pennsylvanians, defend our democracy when it was under attack, and pursued justice for victims of sexual abuse. I am so proud to see that through every challenge he’s encountered, he’s becoming more connected with Pennsylvanians — and even more driven to fight for them. I was with Josh on the night he announced his campaign to become Pennsylvania’s next Governor to keep taking on the big fights for us, and it was a surreal moment. **To watch Josh, someone who cares so deeply about what he’s doing, spend his days fighting to make Pennsylvanians’ lives better makes me so proud — as a Pennsylvanian, and as his dad.** **[That’s the kind of leader Pennsylvania needs. We were counting on these resources to help fund Republicans' final push, but now, we're going to have to make budget cuts that could be the reason why Republicans fail to take back the House and the Senate.

_Can I tell you why I 'm simply not going to accept that?_

| The political pundits may see this as just another election, but for me, this is something deeper and much more personal...

Half of my body was left on a battlefield in Afghanistan. I expected at least an APOLOGY from the so-called Commander In Chief who ensured that this same mission ended with bloodshed, carnage and betrayal.

Instead, not only is this cowardly administration refusing to accept responsibility for the disastrous Afghanistan withdrawal, they are actively trying to hide the truth.

I don't mean to be blunt, but if I can't hold the liars who failed us in the same mission where myself and so many other veterans sacrificed accountable, it will haunt me to my grave.

I need to do this for my fellow veterans over there, including those who saved my life, and especially for the ones who never made it back.

But if I am forced to cut my final campaign budget leading up to Election Day, I may not have the resources to do the ONLY thing that's going to help us get that accountability: _taking back the House from Biden 's enablers!_

So I have authorized an immediate Deadline Extension to make up the roughly $3,000 that still remains on our October Goal.

Can I humbly ask that you help us get back on track by donating whatever you can right now to make up for this missed goal? This would mean so much for our veterans, for our country and for me personally. God bless anyone who is able to pitch in for this fight.

---
Peter,

Last week former President Obama was in Atlanta to campaign for Raphael Warnock and Stacey Abrams.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61789118:J6EyITGNe:m:1:3331421248:764C222A772646F4A8E229DEC437DE12:r)
Democrats know that Georgia is KEY to the Senate majority, so they are using all their big names to make a last-minute pitch for the struggling campaigns of Warnock and Abrams.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61789118:J6EyITGNe:m:1:3331421248:764C222A772646F4A8E229DEC437DE12:r)
They saw how Senator Warnock performed at our debate. They can't believe after spending $60 million to attack me, this race is still tied. And we know they're desperate because we heard it directly from Chuck Schumer and Joe Biden this week during their hot mic moment. **That's why Democrats sounded the alarm and asked President Obama to campaign in Georgia.**

_**What did President Obama have to say about me?**_ He called me a celebrity who wants to be a politician. He got that one wrong. I'm not a celebrity or your typical politician; _I'm a warrior for God._

He got something else wrong, too. He encouraged us to vote for Joe Biden two years ago, didn't he? We've all seen how that's worked out for us - record inflation, open borders, more crime, and less freedom.

**With his poor track record of losing Georgia twice and encouraging us to support Joe Biden, I think President Obama probably needs to sit this one out.**

But here's the thing, Peter. President Obama's visit to Georgia will gin up Democrats and help Senator Warnock raise millions. The moment he got off the stage, my opponent was begging supporters for money.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61789118:J6EyITGNe:m:1:3331421248:764C222A772646F4A8E229DEC437DE12:r)
**[I need your help. We're being outraised by millions, and the gap is growing with President Obama's visit. Will you chip in $5, $10, or even $34 today?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61789118:J6EyITGNe:m:1:3331421248:764C222A772646F4A8E229DEC437DE12:r)**

Thanks for standing with me in these final days.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61789118:J6EyITGNe:m:1:3331421248:764C222A772646F4A8E229DEC437DE12:r)

Herschel Walker

| Greater Georgia Newsletter Thursday, November 3, 2022
We are less than ONE WEEK away from the Tuesday, November 8th general election in Georgia - and although the voter registration deadline has passed, Greater Georgia is out in the field working tirelessly to encourage every last conservative voter to get to the polls on or before next Tuesday.
Remember, the LAST DAY to vote early is tomorrow, November 4th. If you have requested an absentee ballot, you must return it to a monitored absentee ballot drop box by Election Day or make sure it's postmarked and in the mail by Election Day!
To find your early voting location and hours, click [HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001OZ2sDtg-vOklLen-7VlGiQDA39h1aOWmaSsoSts5yuV8zhHvyCqHtzLSvBmXG8gA1eM-5XAEM-14y17KrNpXZIiBb7zvC5aQl4DGaaF-1IzBY6_1ZUictqRbDJUQAnkCYDZ7EBCJ3E5gkHZT4AKd9Q==&c=kwZ8liKGF-te8qTzri-DYds8w1-LQTR1HlXtyJi9LvnwCxx4dJjMgA==&ch=mbvAfIa8j7KEuyJ5vWieFuEJZM0XMoxvDa3JLuVcRGUPG9aySNBSWw==)! If you've submitted an absentee ballot, you can confirm it's been counted by clicking [HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001OZ2sDtg-vOklLen-7VlGiQDA39h1aOWmaSsoSts5yuV8zhHvyCqHtzLSvBmXG8gA8F2e0JIFdC_6Yj5FwpOoo7Lt6qhnZ6qkCu8Ki3DdT-LiGoCeeRI0E5GWyfENRARO-9r2RU3sWu_hXRHUCIsufWQcLIxzNszV96zm3MQTp0g=&c=kwZ8liKGF-te8qTzri-DYds8w1-LQTR1HlXtyJi9LvnwCxx4dJjMgA==&ch=mbvAfIa8j7KEuyJ5vWieFuEJZM0XMoxvDa3JLuVcRGUPG9aySNBSWw==).
---
---
| |
---
| EARLY VOTING UPDATE We are excited to tell you that more than 1.9 MILLION Georgians have already cast ballots early or by absentee in this year's general election - breaking midterm turnout records! Based on the numbers - and the historic turnout of voters from every background - it's clear beyond a doubt that Georgia's SB 202 has made it easier to vote and hard to cheat.
Compared to 2018, early voting turnout is up by about 36%. 1.7M Georgians have voted early and just under 200,000 have voted absentee. Of the 339,000 disenfranchised voters who voted in 2020 but not in the January 2021 runoff, 78,466 have so far come back out to vote. 28,453 voters so far are first-time voters.
You can read our full analysis of Georgia's early voting so far by clicking [HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001OZ2sDtg-vOklLen-7VlGiQDA39h1aOWmaSsoSts5yuV8zhHvyCqHtzLSvBmXG8gA6WnnTHmy_TcOx8B4rtHMV9J17dElAQIJtcgQwcKl5th5M0vElwIo2QAyR1DSUUY1bRQPqeu49pwtTr7wX2csTJDBHRVwbQGHeDdZZ9q6FlEJUksgRM0HWOAKPx901v4o28EHOAn5lkkH1UQw1A9QlkfgHs4qTycJ-p3ozR7ca_duaAO21CT-v98RX-KbegxQ&c=kwZ8liKGF-te8qTzri-DYds8w1-LQTR1HlXtyJi9LvnwCxx4dJjMgA==&ch=mbvAfIa8j7KEuyJ5vWieFuEJZM0XMoxvDa3JLuVcRGUPG9aySNBSWw==).

|

|
---
|

| |

| ELECTION INTEGRITY As early voting continues, Greater Georgia is also working to make sure that every voter knows their vote will count (and their voice will be heard!) in this year's general election.
We've launched a new website that outlines the protections of SB 202, the Georgia Election Integrity Act. Chief among them? Voter ID, a ballot harvesting ban, monitored drop boxes, security paper ballots, and a new voter fraud hotline: 877-725-9797.
Read about the protections [HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001OZ2sDtg-vOklLen-7VlGiQDA39h1aOWmaSsoSts5yuV8zhHvyCqHt9vYTg7tepdmweMg24l3pnGoCi_Q7jnNrOwLpU35pLWhapJ-_-wXk5hlaE9jjNyFQnatvK1kqzNeMrhHoW65P62YAueLQqY4lvXWos08q38A&c=kwZ8liKGF-te8qTzri-DYds8w1-LQTR1HlXtyJi9LvnwCxx4dJjMgA==&ch=mbvAfIa8j7KEuyJ5vWieFuEJZM0XMoxvDa3JLuVcRGUPG9aySNBSWw==), and be sure to share with friends who have questions about our new laws! Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler has been a featured weekly guest on the John Fredericks Show. She is on every Thursday morning at 9:00 AM leading up to Election Day. Listen live by tuning in or clicking [HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001OZ2sDtg-vOklLen-7VlGiQDA39h1aOWmaSsoSts5yuV8zhHvyCqHtzLSvBmXG8gAXshFk0sfF2HuDg_--UdD2KpzCLCHNz0wjSX9SD7rR1PrsYTY5A_tcRv6usbTtrJgJRR5nfX-wTm5wP4ZQpKCdWKuwCfZK8pmmE8LAHO9Cj9P3SDbBr34UA==&c=kwZ8liKGF-te8qTzri-DYds8w1-LQTR1HlXtyJi9LvnwCxx4dJjMgA==&ch=mbvAfIa8j7KEuyJ5vWieFuEJZM0XMoxvDa3JLuVcRGUPG9aySNBSWw==).

| GREATER GEORGIA PROFILE October 22, 2022 Lisa Mascaro, Associated Press
In case you missed it, Greater Georgia and Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler were featured by the Associated Press, with a story about our final voter registration push of 2022. Read the full article [HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001OZ2sDtg-vOklLen-7VlGiQDA39h1aOWmaSsoSts5yuV8zhHvyCqHtzLSvBmXG8gAAQEacwIe3DOc2Q9ykyNPCnrh6MIhNWKR4QEy9dPNe04BlOJ7v5keETOUTAtGuVgzNSlOP2R7tFtx_1LN4l3PlnvVbZ_o333bUalJNqZct7-s9Mgg8l1kK4Y0Fs8oU4RXbGJDy8EnIG1-LsRmtVgCFAvifLud1A7TZSuS8kYYEgZSP0bp1rK6q1_uXyWd7K9oRWYCV2idg1w=&c=kwZ8liKGF-te8qTzri-DYds8w1-LQTR1HlXtyJi9LvnwCxx4dJjMgA==&ch=mbvAfIa8j7KEuyJ5vWieFuEJZM0XMoxvDa3JLuVcRGUPG9aySNBSWw==), or view the excerpt below:
"On a crisp fall morning, eager volunteers fanned out in the leafy suburban Atlanta neighborhood to knock on doors, trying to persuade reluctant and skeptical conservatives to register to vote in next month's midterm elections...Dispatching the group on the hunt for votes was an unlikely emissary -- [former Republican Sen. Kelly Loeffler](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001OZ2sDtg-vOklLen-7VlGiQDA39h1aOWmaSsoSts5yuV8zhHvyCqHtzLSvBmXG8gADSe20FfAU3Mtfs9Fy2Cmac1iMUDvr8DRB7zpzXBgsNLKOJ1wMbpzzD8y-MH1R-qxSZkeUM9c4gb-IoEpl6P4jrQk9UKpFEhR97agEHMN8UoWSYQX-CBzVLrzlJxeH3kxuUZEe6Dj021wGSmpJ-PvT9bsTMaCCDWUej6s6DwpolfQKXRF69Dtng==&c=kwZ8liKGF-te8qTzri-DYds8w1-LQTR1HlXtyJi9LvnwCxx4dJjMgA==&ch=mbvAfIa8j7KEuyJ5vWieFuEJZM0XMoxvDa3JLuVcRGUPG9aySNBSWw==), who initially stood by the defeated president's effort to undo Joe Biden's victory, but was now working, in blue jeans and a country plaid shirt, to bring election skeptics back to the polls. clean_body: | | | | | == | | | Greater Georgia Newsletter Thursday, November 3, 2022 We are less than ONE WEEK away from the Tuesday, November 8th general election in Georgia - and although the voter registration deadline has passed, Greater Georgia is out in the field working tirelessly to encourage every last conservative voter to get to the polls on or before next Tuesday. Remember, the LAST DAY to vote early is tomorrow, November 4th. If you have requested an absentee ballot, you must return it to a monitored absentee ballot drop box by Election Day or make sure it's postmarked and in the mail by Election Day! To find your early voting location and hours, click ==! If you've submitted an absentee ballot, you can confirm it's been counted by clicking ==. | | | EARLY VOTING UPDATE We are excited to tell you that more than 1.9 MILLION Georgians have already cast ballots early or by absentee in this year's general election - breaking midterm turnout records! Based on the numbers - and the historic turnout of voters from every background - it's clear beyond a doubt that Georgia's SB 202 has made it easier to vote and hard to cheat. Compared to 2018, early voting turnout is up by about 36%. 1.7M Georgians have voted early and just under 200,000 have voted absentee. Of the 339,000 disenfranchised voters who voted in 2020 but not in the January 2021 runoff, 78,466 have so far come back out to vote. 28,453 voters so far are first-time voters. You can read our full analysis of Georgia's early voting so far by clicking ==. | | | | | | | ELECTION INTEGRITY As early voting continues, Greater Georgia is also working to make sure that every voter knows their vote will count (and their voice will be heard!) in this year's general election. We've launched a new website that outlines the protections of SB 202, the Georgia Election Integrity Act. Chief among them? Voter ID, a ballot harvesting ban, monitored drop boxes, security paper ballots, and a new voter fraud hotline: 877-725-9797. Read about the protections ==, and be sure to share with friends who have questions about our new laws! You can also listen to our latest election integrity radio ad below! | == | | | LATEST EVENTS GET OUT THE VOTE PUSH Since the voter registration deadline on October 11, Greater Georgia has been out in the community close to early voting locations - reminding voters to get out and cast their ballots ahead of Election Day! Hall County Halloween Festival on 10/31, Cobb County Gun Store Early Voting Event on 10/29, Whitfield County Dia de los Muertos Festival on 10/29, Fulton County Diwali Celebration on 10/22 | | | | | MINORITY OUTREACH EFFORTS In the last month, Greater Georgia hosted and attended several minority outreach events including a Hispanic Heritage Month celebration, and voter registration drives in front of Latino supermarkets. Hispanic Heritage Month Celebration on 9/24, Hispanic Registration Drives on 10/9 | | | | | RED WAVE REGISTRATION RALLY Greater Georgia reached over 13,000 conservative voters in the final days leading up to the October 11th registration deadline, including by texts, postcards, canvassing, and in-person voter registration drives. Thank you to all who came to participate! Postcard Party on 09/30, Red Wave Registration Rally on 10/08, Grocery Store Registration Drives on 10/11 | | | | | | | | | IN THE NEWS JOHN FREDERICKS RADIO SHOW Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler has been a featured weekly guest on the John Fredericks Show. She is on every Thursday morning at 9:00 AM leading up to Election Day. Listen live by tuning in or clicking ==. | == | GREATER GEORGIA PROFILE October 22, 2022 Lisa Mascaro, Associated Press In case you missed it, Greater Georgia and Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler were featured by the Associated Press, with a story about our final voter registration push of 2022. Read the full article ==, or view the excerpt below: "On a crisp fall morning, eager volunteers fanned out in the leafy suburban Atlanta neighborhood to knock on doors, trying to persuade reluctant and skeptical conservatives to register to vote in next month's midterm elections...Dispatching the group on the hunt for votes was an unlikely emissary -- ==, who initially stood by the defeated president's effort to undo Joe Biden's victory, but was now working, in blue jeans and a country plaid shirt, to bring election skeptics back to the polls. "We saw it firsthand in our election," Loeffler said about the drop-off during an interview outside the Cobb County Republican Party headquarters where the volunteers gathered on a recent Saturday." == | | | ON SOCIAL MEDIA | == == == | == == == | | | NEWS TO WATCH | == - Georgia lawmakers could consider increasing state's tax incentives for music production == - Consumer prices surge higher than expected, up 8.2% == - Kemp plans to sharpen anti-gang penalties, limit no-cash bail == - Biden Administration funds studies on danger of transgender hormonal treatments even as it pushes them on kids == - Big Georgia turnout in week one driven by in-person voters | | | To learn more, visit ==, and follow along on ==, ==, and == to stay up to date with the latest information. | | == | | | Paid for by Greater Georgia Action, Inc. body:
| | |
---
Friend —
I’ve served my country in the Navy, at NASA, and now in the Senate.
No matter where I’ve been or what I was doing, I’ve always used science, data, and facts to make tough decisions.
And right now, the facts tell me that we’re in trouble.
National Republicans are attacking the right to abortion, denying the devastating impact climate change is having on our planet, and spreading misinformation about the integrity of our elections nationwide. **But I refuse to let them win.**
I didn’t spend more than 54 days in space observing the damage climate change is wreaking on our planet just for far-right extremists to deny the truth and refuse to take action. I think our leaders should follow the facts, listen to the science, and act decisively — [**will you split a donation of $5 between my campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand’s if you agree?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53941852/376971704/1415649524?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk3744-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZWZmMzJiMi04NDViLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=je8kFHcGSopc8UydRILiEqm0TZtgGbVE_bMdarpr2gk=)
I didn’t serve 25 years in the Navy just for Republicans to threaten our country from within by sowing doubt and misinformation about the integrity of our elections. Our leaders should respect the will of the voters and free and fair elections — [**if you agree, will you split a $5 donation between my campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand’s?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53941854/376971706/1415649524?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk3744-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZWZmMzJiMi04NDViLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=je8kFHcGSopc8UydRILiEqm0TZtgGbVE_bMdarpr2gk=)

[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=885d88e0e8284021878fc4d5f27fcbeb&_e=euSjYIKvaSm2615Vq1YtK-BtmRxVi7hPZwgQHSJ8QmBHlQHyVCKUXUsWiv40t4W0VZjxRJt0YSpnLB8JAnci9CFvsqGfs48miF35TCcHgM-U2ZNb9Pyo4uLNiJ64iLXecehpKfbFpC8tB-ssqwGYvZnF-WHlh5af06Rl6itevihTMJb4ShFLBYhlGOiN3dQObJOxULBKlxOpRZhTpVhHX5Bl4wMglFopqLKnhDQGePg%3D)
---
Friend, This nurse practitioner's story deserves to go viral. It's a devastating example of what will continue to happen if we don't draw the line for freedom. [**_That 's why we're suing CVS_**** _._**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=885d88e0e8284021878fc4d5f27fcbeb&_e=euSjYIKvaSm2615Vq1YtK-BtmRxVi7hPZwgQHSJ8QmBHlQHyVCKUXUsWiv40t4W09NYJr979MWxS5LvXt0_JpW7dfQQ2NWtrNbYCUZ1ZOF5Sij1zh0LXwHnzuvcUMonHZ6Qcfwio3Y_H-SBuz9K2wChks8n5RTQZ6J94Zs3m2gTuV_iaMn-Ub5IKT8eQsIbq5j8BM2IPZaBmXnZPOUsgr7GWjTyppBgTGobWIhUFFFk%3D) But I'm getting ahead of myself. Paige Casey is a young nurse practitioner. For years, she faithfully served her community, working as a nurse practitioner at a local CVS MinuteClinic in Virginia. When she was hired, she made her employer aware that her Catholic faith prevented her from prescribing or dispensing abortion-inducing drugs._ _ CVS accommodated her religious conviction for three-and-a-half years and didn't require her to administer any life-ending drugs. But then in 2022, they told Paige they would no longer allow her religious freedom. A few months later, **_she was fired --just two days after earning a performance-based raise._** **This is blatant religious discrimination, and according to Virginia law -- it's illegal.**
---
| | [**SIGN THE PETITION**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=885d88e0e8284021878fc4d5f27fcbeb&_e=euSjYIKvaSm2615Vq1YtK-BtmRxVi7hPZwgQHSJ8QmBHlQHyVCKUXUsWiv40t4W08Sm8aoSJsD7ucG7iRjFI-pu9lNEfLYm_8UwPI8mP4TPDSV0XCGSm8lTj0Do82XLec_FXxZjsuMqXDR4ofapUo5VwWtkZhHIYSNaD3vtlN6DFn9drmSlBR69f5IYaYDgw9t4qX02iVv10o0E5cKszLKg286Gm8zsnP_FVjeTVouA%3D)
---
With the ongoing effects still felt from the pandemic, health care workers are needed now more than ever. Forcing them to choose between violating their faith or being fired **_hurts everyone. _** **_And it 's downright un-American. _** Patients are best served by doctors, nurses, and other medical professionals who are free to act ethically and consistent with their beliefs. Despite having a spotless record, Paige is now _unemployed_ , simply because she stood for her faith. This unlawful discrimination cannot be allowed to stand. That's why Alliance Defending Freedom is filing a lawsuit against CVS on behalf of Paige. ADF is the world's largest legal organization committed to protecting religious freedom, free speech, marriage and family, parental rights, and the sanctity of life. We defend your most cherished liberties in Congress, state legislatures, and courtrooms across the country -- all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court if necessary. [**But we need your help. clean_body: | | | Friend, This nurse practitioner's story deserves to go viral. It's a devastating example of what will continue to happen if we don't draw the line for freedom. But I'm getting ahead of myself. Paige Casey is a young nurse practitioner. For years, she faithfully served her community, working as a nurse practitioner at a local CVS MinuteClinic in Virginia. When she was hired, she made her employer aware that her Catholic faith prevented her from prescribing or dispensing abortion-inducing drugs. CVS accommodated her religious conviction for three-and-a-half years and didn't require her to administer any life-ending drugs. But then in 2022, they told Paige they would no longer allow her religious freedom. A few months later, she was fired --just two days after earning a performance-based raise. This is blatant religious discrimination, and according to Virginia law -- it's illegal. | | With the ongoing effects still felt from the pandemic, health care workers are needed now more than ever. Forcing them to choose between violating their faith or being fired hurts everyone. And it 's downright un-American. Patients are best served by doctors, nurses, and other medical professionals who are free to act ethically and consistent with their beliefs. Despite having a spotless record, Paige is now unemployed , simply because she stood for her faith. This unlawful discrimination cannot be allowed to stand. That's why Alliance Defending Freedom is filing a lawsuit against CVS on behalf of Paige. ADF is the world's largest legal organization committed to protecting religious freedom, free speech, marriage and family, parental rights, and the sanctity of life. We defend your most cherished liberties in Congress, state legislatures, and courtrooms across the country -- all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court if necessary. We the People, CVS customers, will not stand by and watch attacks on the religious rights of all Americans. Thank you in advance. body:
Sunday, November 6th at 7:30pm

Hi Peroutka Prayer Warriors,

Who is joining us on Sunday? We have only heard from one county: Worcester has committed to joining us in prayer at 7:30pm. Let’s hear it for the great patriots in Worcester for being the very first to step up!! Can we get all 24 jurisdictions to gather? It is so powerful when we join all across the entire state. Who’s in?

Michael really loves this, please make every attempt to log in on Sunday (and send pics if you can!)

Grab a friend or two, open up your laptop and log in at 7:30pm. You’ll get to see Michael singing, playing guitar, ad worshipping his favorite things to do. It could just be your own family in your house after dinner, out you could arrange a large group in a hall or where your club already meets. Anything goes, just try to pray with someone else rather than alone if you can....it’s much more powerful and we need strength in numbers!

This prayer service will be a joyful tribute: will give thanks for just how far we have come as a state, for the friendships we have made, and for putting God first again in all that we do. We will give thanks for everything Michael stands for and has taught us. We will give thanks for this incredible leader who has never ever budged an inch on the truth, despite endless attacks from the enemy. We will give thanks for all this and more and we will come together to urgently pray that God grant Michael victory next week and restore Maryland to the rule of law. We will give thanks for what is about to happen.......

Please let us know if your county can commit, it’s so much fun to be able to tell Michael how many people are with him in prayer.....he is really counting on every single one of us. Please forward the link below to everyone you can, the more that join, the stronger we are.

Bring to an end the violence of the wicked and make the righteous secure. Psalm 7:9

body:
Fellow Conservative:

Like most conservatives, you're getting countless emails and text messages right now asking for political donations.
But how do you make your contributions truly count?
We have an answer that we believe will help you do the most to elect the right leaders to Congress.
It's called the House Freedom Fund.
We're a grassroots organization dedicated to defending and growing the ranks of the House Freedom Caucus, which is the group of courageous conservatives in Congress that fights for an open, accountable, and limited government.
✓ We only endorse candidates who are members of the Freedom Caucus or who have pledged to join after they're elected.
This is important because, without the accountability and leverage that comes with being part of this group, the Swamp will chew up the people we send to Washington and render them ineffective.
✓ We also make it possible for you to contribute directly to their campaigns so they can control how the funds are spent to win undecided voters and turn out voters to the polls.
Please join us by making a split contribution to these conservative U.S. House candidates now!
Your donations will instantly go into their bank accounts and be available in the final days and minutes of this historic election.
▶︎ Jim Bognet (PA-08)▶︎ Kelly Cooper (AZ-04)▶︎ Eli Crane (AZ-02)▶︎ Yvette Herrell (NM-02)▶︎ Bo Hines (NC-13)▶︎ Joe Kent (WA-03)▶︎ Karoline Leavitt (NH-01)▶︎ Anna Paulina Luna (FL-13)▶︎ Max Miller (OH-07)▶︎ Scotty Moore (FL-09)▶︎ Sarah
Palin (AK-AL)▶︎ Neil Parrott (MD-06)▶︎ Scott Perry (PA-10)▶︎ Sam Peters (NV-04)▶︎ David Schweikert (AZ-06)▶︎ Sandy Smith (NC-01)▶︎ Yesli Vega (VA-07)
These candidates are not only strong, proven conservatives, but they are also running in competitive races where your support is needed.
The 2022 midterm elections give conservatives the opportunity to put the brakes on the Left's radical agenda and begin the process of rolling back their destructive policies!
We can't miss this opportunity to send true conservatives to Congress. RINOs won't solve the problem and will likely make it worse. We need a conservative majority, and that will only happen if we add new members to the House Freedom Caucus.
Please make a split donation to our priority candidates now!
Thank you for considering this request and for doing so much to help fight for America's future!

Sincerely,

Ray Yonkura
Executive Director
House Freedom Fund

STATEMENT from MICHAEL ANTHONY PEROUTKA REGARDING VOTING ON NOVEMBER 8th November 3, 2022 Without free and fair elections we don’t have a country. Dr. Douglas Frank, a 40-year modeler of pandemics and elections, has claimed that the officially reported results for the 2020 General Election were indeed altered by means of an algorithm designed to manipulate election results to achieve a predetermined outcome. **_ _** At Dr. Frank’s suggestion, concerned citizens have conducted canvasses in several Maryland counties to discover evidence of fraud.
It is my understanding that information collected in these counties indicated a significant number of inconsistencies. Anomalies were found when public information contained in the Board of Elections data and the National Change of Address lists were compared with the answers that residents gave the canvassers regarding voting behaviors in the 2020 election. Evidence collected has been and will be turned over to appropriate law enforcement entities. One of the key issues in my campaign is the restoration and assurance of election integrity in Maryland. Nationally known experts including legal counsel have recommended that Marylanders who are concerned about election integrity can take the following action that may serve to mitigate the effects of a suspected manipulative algorithm. These safeguards include:
* Vote on November 8th. Later in the day, if possible
* Use a paper ballot. (not touchscreen)

By sharing this information and these suggestions, neither Michael Peroutka nor the Peroutka campaign is making any accusation of voting fraud. This is intended as the sharing of information which those who demand transparent elections may find to be helpful.

| Peter,
November 8 isn't just the day we are taking Nevada back from a corrupt, soft-on-crime Governor...
It's also the day our NEXT Governor - proven law enforcement leader Sheriff Joe Lombardo - is celebrating his BIRTHDAY!

body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61789694:JhhCdTGsN:m:1:3253819041:D33B1D8316EB4606D0ABF4369D550406:r)
Hello Peter,

Did you know that your taxpayer dollars fund the pensions of convicted congressional criminals?

That's right. **Your hard-earned tax dollars are helping to support former members of Congress found guilty of crimes or serious ethical violations.**

A recent review of the cases of 11 congressional members convicted of criminal activity since 2007 who also qualified for a pension (plus the two members of the House censured for serious ethical violations) revealed some shocking information.

**All 13 convicted or censured congress members were still receiving their pensions, leaving taxpayers like you on the hook for nearly $4 MILLION total.**

How is that fair to you?

Let me introduce myself. My name is Pete Sepp, President of the National Taxpayers Union (NTU). We are fighting for taxpayers to revoke these privileges and rein in corruption.

[_**I am personally asking for your immediate help. My goal is to raise $13,000 _(or $1,000 per former lawmaker)_ this weekend so we can hold these congressional criminals accountable. Can you send a gift of $25, $35, $50, or any amount? Click here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61789694:JhhCdTGsN:m:1:3253819041:D33B1D8316EB4606D0ABF4369D550406:r)

Fifteen years ago, Congress passed the Honest Leadership and Open Government Act (HLOGA) to stop Congressional felons from receiving a taxpayer-funded pension. Another, even "tougher" law followed in 2012.

**But so far, not a single congressional felon has faced the consequences of their actions.**

Right now, former Rep. Stephen Buyer, R-Ind., is having insider trading charges brought against him. IF he is convicted of those charges and his taxpayer-funded pension stripped, **he would be the first member of Congress ever held accountable under these laws.**

Obviously, the current pension forfeiture laws have not provided
adequate deterrence.

Reforms are needed to protect taxpayers and to shed transparency on enforcing forfeiture laws.

[_**Do you think we should protect taxpayers from subsidizing Congressional wrongdoers? You can help NTU put a STOP to this practice. All you have to do is send your urgent gift today >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61789694:JhhCdTGsN:m:1:3253819041:D33B1D8316EB4606D0ABF4369D550406:r)

Special interests have their lobbyists. But who is working for you as a taxpayer?

It's simple -- the National Taxpayers Union.

Since 1969, NTU has proudly been a major player in signature taxpayer victories of the past five decades:
* We were there when the federal tax code was overhauled under President Reagan in 1986.
* We championed the cause for a "Taxpayer Bill of Rights" in the late 80s and 90s and with follow-on legislation, the 2019 Taxpayer First Act.
* In 2017, NTU was the driving force behind the successful push for comprehensive tax reform.
* In 2020, our public education arm launched the Taxpayer Defense Center to fight for taxpayers in court. TDC has already helped to hand the IRS two major defeats in the Supreme Court.

It's time to stop wasting taxpayer dollars on corrupt politicians.

clean_body: Hello Peter, Did you know that your taxpayer dollars fund the pensions of convicted congressional criminals? That's right. Your hard-earned tax dollars are helping to support former members of Congress found guilty of crimes or serious ethical violations. A recent review of the cases of 11 congressional members convicted of criminal activity since 2007 who also qualified for a pension (plus the two members of the House censured for serious ethical violations) revealed some shocking information. All 13 convicted or censured congress members were still receiving their pensions, leaving taxpayers like you on the hook for nearly $4 MILLION total. How is that fair to you? Let me introduce myself. My name is Pete Sepp, President of the National Taxpayers Union (NTU). We are fighting for taxpayers to revoke these privileges and rein in corruption. Fifteen years ago, Congress passed the Honest Leadership and Open Government Act (HLOGA) to stop Congressional felons from receiving a taxpayer-funded pension. Another, even "tougher" law followed in 2012. But so far, not a single congressional felon has faced the consequences of their actions. Right now, former Rep. Stephen Buyer, R-Ind., is having insider trading charges brought against him. IF he is convicted of those charges and his taxpayer-funded pension stripped, he would be the first member of Congress ever held accountable under these laws. Obviously, the current pension forfeiture laws have not provided adequate deterrence. Reforms are needed to protect taxpayers and to shed transparency on enforcing forfeiture laws. Special interests have their lobbyists. But who is working for you as a taxpayer? It's simple -- the National Taxpayers Union. Since 1969, NTU has proudly been a major player in signature taxpayer victories of the past five decades: We were there when the federal tax code was overhauled under President Reagan in 1986. We championed the cause for a "Taxpayer Bill of Rights" in the late 80s and 90s and with follow-on legislation, the 2019 Taxpayer First Act. In 2017, NTU was the driving force behind the successful push for comprehensive tax reform. In 2020, our public education arm launched the Taxpayer Defense Center to fight for taxpayers in court. TDC has already helped to hand the IRS two major defeats in the Supreme Court. It's time to stop wasting taxpayer dollars on corrupt politicians. Can you join the fight and help NTU stop corruption and waste in DC? Click below to send your gift. Thank you, Pete Sepp President National Taxpayers Union NTU is a 501(c)(4) nonprofit, nonpartisan citizen group whose members work every day for lower taxes and smaller government at all levels. Email from SOTS Office Saying Results of Election Could be delayed.

Dear ,

Did you see this email that just came out from the Secretary of the State’s Office? They are already saying to expect a delay in results due to an “increase in absentee ballots,” one week out from the election.

We are expecting 70% fewer absentee ballots in 2022 compared to 2020. There is no reason for the Secretary of the State’s office to scare voters with the promise of delayed results.

What this email is really saying is that our election infrastructure is failing. What we saw during the primary in August were failing machines. I am hearing from officials all over the state that the registration system is constantly down.

It is time for a change. As your next Secretary of the State, I will bring technology to the forefront of our elections. No excuses and no delayed results.

Onward to Election Day!

Thank you and Godspeed,

Dominic Rapini

Republican Candidate for Secretary of the State

Peter,

Last week former President Obama was in Atlanta to campaign for Raphael Warnock and Stacey Abrams.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61789583:6nKdHTGND:m:1:3364136623:82ED881C3AE8ACCB9C38832EC31B78CE:r)
Democrats know that Georgia is KEY to the Senate majority, so they are using all their big names to make a last-minute pitch for the struggling campaigns of Warnock and Abrams.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61789583:6nKdHTGND:m:1:3364136623:82ED881C3AE8ACCB9C38832EC31B78CE:r)
They saw how Senator Warnock performed at our debate. They can't believe after spending $60 million to attack me, this race is still tied. And we know they're desperate because we heard it directly from Chuck Schumer and Joe Biden this week during their hot mic moment. **That's why Democrats sounded the alarm and asked President Obama to campaign in Georgia.**

_**What did President Obama have to say about me?**_ He called me a celebrity who wants to be a politician. He got that one wrong. I'm not a celebrity or your typical politician; _I'm a warrior for God._

He got something else wrong, too. He encouraged us to vote for Joe Biden two years ago, didn't he? We've all seen how that's worked out for us - record inflation, open borders, more crime, and less freedom.

**With his poor track record of losing Georgia twice and encouraging us to support Joe Biden, I think President Obama probably needs to sit this one out.**

But here's the thing, Peter. President Obama's visit to Georgia will gin up Democrats and help Senator Warnock raise millions. The moment he got off the stage, my opponent was begging supporters for money.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61789583:6nKdHTGND:m:1:3364136623:82ED881C3AE8ACCB9C38832EC31B78CE:r)
**[I need your help. We're being outraised by millions, and the gap is growing with President Obama's visit. Will you chip in $5, $10, or even $34 today?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61789583:6nKdHTGND:m:1:3364136623:82ED881C3AE8ACCB9C38832EC31B78CE:r)**

Thanks for standing with me in these final days.

Herschel Walker

I'm George Santos, a first-generation American, a conservative, and I'm fighting to win the nation's "**Swingiest Swing District** " here in suburban Long Island, New York.
On Election Day, a handful of races will come down to the wire and determine control of the U.S. House of Representatives. My district, **New York 's 3rd, will be one of those nail-biters.**
**This seat is 100% winnable for Republicans** , _especially_ in a Red Wave year like 2022...but this is still New York. We're up against a _lot_ of Dark Money and our state's well-oiled Democratic machine.
To win, **I need to rely on the generosity of patriots across the nation**...and that's why I hope I can count you in for a small, finish line investment in my campaign. **[Are you someone I can depend on?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61790036:6Gb7HTGyN:m:1:3350876382:5DA31A11E183C25200D05B5AA48A4FA7:r)**

* We ALREADY proved a conservative can win. In November 2021, **Republicans _swept_ all of our local elections**...winning Nassau County Supervisor for the first time in _years_.

* **Democrats have been panicking for months.** In fact, the Democrat incumbent decided to _retire_ rather than face me on Election Day.

* **And now,_even Far-Left Media outlets_ are panicking**...with CNN writing articles like, **" How the red wave could slam hard into deep-blue New York."**

All of this is a recipe for a FLIP on November 8...but like I said: this is still New York and this is still a Swing District. **Anything can happen, especially because we 're being _badly_ outspent by the Democrats.**

It means **taking our country back by electing a whole slate of strong, principled, fearless conservatives**...who will NOT play by the Left's rules and NOT sell out our country, like far too many Republicans have in the past.

Voters are ready to send me to Washington, and I'm ready to fight the minute I get there. **The only thing standing in my way is a lack of resources.**
