Just a quick note NOT asking for money. I know the flood of emails and texts and snail mail asking for money is exhausting — and that times are tough right now for so many. I want to be direct and say that I never expect you to be able to respond to each message with a donation — and we’re grateful to have you on this team no matter how much or how often you’re able to donate. Chipping in with a donation is just one way to get involved. It’s important that we do what we can — donate, make calls, put up yard signs, put out messages on social media — because we’re so close in so many races. I’ve kept it up because I’m trying to help — and I know you are too. Take the email I sent yesterday for Mandela Barnes: The contributions to that email can help keep him on television in this closing week of his race. It can help make sure his field organizers have gas money. It can ensure there’s coffee in the pot and cookies on the table when volunteers get back from door knocking. And it will help build strong teams for elections to come. This team has supported candidates like him across the country. John Fetterman. Katie Porter. Tina Kotek. Catherine Cortez-Masto. Maggie Hassan. Raphael Warnock. Tony Evers. Good people whose races are on a knife’s edge. Good people who may win or lose based on a handful of votes. And whether they win or lose will have a lot to do with where our nation goes next on abortion rights. On the survival of Social Security and Medicare. On $35 insulin. On whether Democrats can stay in the climate fight. On whether our democracy survives. So I don’t want to wake up on the day after the election and talk about the good people who lost by just a bit — and say I wish I’d done a little bit more. Me — I’m giving it everything I’ve got. I’m grateful for everything that every one of you has already done. And I’m grateful for the chance to be in this fight with you. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

Hello Friend,

Election Day is just five days away.

If you have already voted early or by mail, thank you for making this election a priority

My entire career has been about supporting Broward County children. Nothing is more important to me than their education and safety. I have been a PTA President, a Guardian Ad Litem, a Teacher at Western High School, my alma mater, and your County-Wide School Board Member.

Today, November 3rd, is the last fundraising day for this election.

Will you help me finish this race strong and make a financial contribution to help me reach more voters in these final days of this election?

Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/elect-donna-korn-1]

I'm so grateful for your support.

Thank you,

Donna Korn for Broward County School Board

Team, Election Day is less than a week away, and we’re getting conflicting signals.

**First, the bad news:** Across the country, Republican lawmakers have passed onerous new voter suppression measures. **CNN is reporting that these GOP laws could “make it harder to replicate the record turnout” that helped Democrats win in 2020.**
**The NDRC has endorsed nearly 500 Democracy Defenders in key races across the country, many of whom are in tied races with their extreme GOP opponents._That means Republican voter suppression tactics could make or break their chances of victory!_**
[Help the NDRC defend democracy: Donate](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53930791/376927054/1344431854?amount=30&refcode=20221103.2r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVkMzRiMDcwLTc3NWItZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=YklanDk2zHqIvmU4EA6INvV3pZGI14M22r8R1ppizy0=)

**We know that, when turnout is high, Democrats win. But with the polls showing _tight_ races in battleground states, we can’t afford to take anything for granted.**

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

| | Dear Fellow Pro-Life American, Planned Parenthood is holding NOTHING back. Their murderous business has taken a hit after _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned, so they're going all-out this year to the elect the most pro-abortion Congress in history! **Planned Parenthood recently announced they are planning to spend a record-breaking $50 MILLION to elect abortion-loving politicians who will enshrine abortion into federal law and boost their bottom line.** I need your help to fight back against their anti-life, pro-abortion propaganda. The only way we can make America fully and forever abortion free is by exposing the Abortion Lobby for what they are: Murderers! [**Will you help us go toe-to-toe with Planned Parenthood this election season (and beyond!) by making a much-needed gift to Operation Rescue right now?**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-Q) **Operation Rescue has released 9-1-1 calls from abortion clinics where people and politicians can hear for themselves the dangers of these so-called "healthcare facilities."** **We've also interviewed sources from within the clinics and brought information to law enforcement that has FORCED them to invoke fines and sometimes make arrests.** _Since Roe was overturned, Operation Rescue has led the charge to close 60+ abortion clinics PERMANENTLY. _ And as a result, more than **_TEN THOUSAND_** innocent children have been saved, according to a recent study. [**This is all made possible thanks to the support of pro-life warriors like you. Today, I'm hoping I can count on you to pledge $50 or more to help Operation Rescue continue our good work.**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._3OnCFHJgCa28w) We can't let Planned Parenthood and the rest of the Abortion Lobby control the narrative. Of course, we know the truth, but millions of Americans who aren't as involved as we are could fall victim to their propaganda! Planned Parenthood is planning on targeting vulnerable women with their propaganda, just like they always have, to boost their bottom line. They're going to spend TENS OF MILLIONS pushing the lie that abortion is "healthcare" and a "constitutional right." **Operation Rescue isn't going to let them win. We're working day-in and day-out to expose the Abortion Cartel!**
---
[**Help Operation Rescue Take on the Abortion Cartel**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._QE1ZapUaiosg)
---
Operation Rescue has closed more abortion clinics than any other organization in history, and we've done it by telling the truth and exposing these murderous organizations. We truly can't do this without support for pro-life warriors like you. That's why I'm counting on our strongest Pro-Life Champions like you to join me in this fight. **As the ONLY organization working every day to expose the Abortion Cartel and put them out of business, Operation Rescue has never backed down from the Goliath-sized Planned Parenthood -- and with you by our side we never will!**
---
[**Help Operation Rescue Take on the Abortion Lobby**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)
---
Planned Parenthood is doing everything they can to destroy Pro-Life laws at the state and federal level. They are pouring $50 MILLION into this election cycle because they want their abortion-loving allies writing the legislation! [**Can I can count on you to make your best gift of $50, $100, or whatever you can give right now? **](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.) **Remember, if we don't stay on offense to expose Planned Parenthood for their lies,_no one else will_. ** So, thank you in advance for your help today. Lives will be rescued and Pro-Life victories safeguarded through your support!
---
God bless,
---
Troy Newman President Operation Rescue

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zug8sckh3ml5kq26quhvb2s0fpk04auh1hg5h668_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5ie2o35c5h2bs "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zqeq616vj1c8k4eov8nijhiuu0b9jnpkblu14bog_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5ie2o35c5h2bs "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zrb8sh0sjca67ep7ntpnvkgrsqik9p7f0av4tb48_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5ie2o35c5h2bs "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z6mqq566eps90bv5tfmvh95h277vo8at65f0446o_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5ie2o35c5h2bs "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zsumm7ud1ebonhg9lnpqii4a37g4c7l0q2hi070g_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5ie2o35c5h2bs "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z2mf92vv4j398ipgvtpa3erk2bni71qmu2t2aq2o_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5ie2o35c5h2bs "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z245fcunif2vuklu86aenal34ur0lb83d51g6foo_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5ie2o35c5h2bs "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zulqe5cb57e418dvvf2e6gltt2ldb8l1uaiifnl0_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5ie2o35c5h2bs "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family has decided to take on a new challenge. I made the choice to run for U.S. Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z83dtvslpgfktl3ho7g0nmc9cja58q67h7umchto_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5ie2o35c5h2bs "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5ndckpnjn2alqr1j8f2o3ntfhj1svp1vqm1v82g_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5ie2o35c5h2bs "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zs19qljds69h19pb12praovgu738o26cp5aliiqo_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5ie2o35c5h2bs "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z37ppu111958hnvnuh96fn29bdnlqagb01994ol8_rp22sh2s8i66or7c5ie2o35c5h2bs "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---

body:
Hold this Senate seat!
| | | | |
---
| | | _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T73e69e49-d20b-439a-b29b-6a11b4b92870/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._
---
|
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, **_It doesn't get more straightforward than this: The election prognosticators at FiveThirtyEight just released an analysis: If Senator Warnock holds onto his seat, Democrats have a 91% chance of holding the Senate. _** **_Let me say that again. If we reelect Rev. Warnock to the U.S. Senate, there is more than a 9 in 10 chance Democrats will be in the majority. _** [**_So will you join us in rushing $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can afford to The Warnock for Senate Campaign, so they can keep their ads on TV, continuing to hammer their message home and ensuring we keep the Senate_**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T29ca7b7e-04ae-4680-847e-eee7b721e0f3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
|
---
| | | | [**DONATE NOW: SEN. WARNOCK FOR GEORGIA**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tce823797-e464-4951-98a5-a2b61b49a4f0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| **_Yet, while recent polls show Reverend Warnock slightly ahead of Herschel Walker, they are WAY TOO CLOSE to provide any comfort. Yes, it is insane that this brilliant, compassionate giant of a man, Raphael Warnock, even has a chance of losing to Herschel Walker. _** **_Walker, who can't speak coherently on any policy , has threatened to murder multiple women--including his ex wife by putting a gun up to her head--and wants to ban all abortion, when a woman's life is in danger, but every week we find out about a new woman he took to an abortion clinic._**

**_We can't do anything about that, but we can ensure Senator Warnock wins, and wins big. So we keep cutting the price of prescription drugs and make the anti-poverty, child-tax credit permanent, confirm judges and other appointments and even a potential Supreme Court nominee, without GOP filibusters and chaos. _** [**_So will you join us in rushing $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can afford to The Warnock for Senate Campaign, so they can keep their ads on TV, continuing to hammer their message home and ensuring we keep the Senate?_**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6a1213d4-f734-464b-8b59-0a5d74829ece/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **_This is it folks, the final week. Please stand with us as we support our best candidates and fight for every inch of ground. We will never give in to bullies and demagogues._** **All my best,**
**Cliff Schecter**

We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! name: Doyle Canning
subject: Inside: My Voter's Guide, Plus Ways to Help
body:
You may have seen some shady mailers coming to your home promoting Green Party candidate Mike Beilstein on a platform that sounds...familiar? | |
---
|
---
Dear friends and supporters, **Thank you to everyone who came out to support Oregon Democrats for last week's epic rallies with Senator Bernie Sanders in Eugene and Portland!** As I told the crowd at the UO campus, "We must walk forward together today, for our right to control our own bodies, and our own destinies, to love who we love, to be who we are, to get a good education, make a good living, and provide for our families, to make our own healthcare decisions and to elect our own leaders. And we commit to vote like all of that is on the line, because it is - it is on your ballot right now. " This year, I urge you to...
1. Vote early - Don’t wait till Election Day!
2. Use a ballot drop box ([click here to find yours](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTJup836pU-BL_IxqhEV6ocfI517icdI4b7doAHhWQMh2eLAc76EgsP_R6k1yBoWFeuHUWNizBUGt_k3LS10iF5bcLuwBwdDWLndaAiXRD8oh-mTlXoVRMCE2c8jfGMrzV-2ccahQhyRbtG4UUowwoKoWJPoaiHgLDJ1eIz9xBAdv-N6o_26d7f3jKQguuKOmjPdC9e79MUNT4UneK0xNbAHHhp2Ea-PNYSs6wRzNNjVbpInI40Wo69DffBK-fDoY5S5U-vNkCOsIFXQDFyuMdhr8kcrXAxlJWCStZI51926nhzuI103ZtpPPzfwHIJM-0A/3qu/Vvm9wzZSSJmQKLqgIQwlRg/h0/qwSVqbTE3l5SC9JBbX0oUBAsiv5eCLykum-eXDRRZTU))
3. Definitely Vote Democrat up and down the ticket!

But before you mark your ballot, check out my voters guide below, some endorsements I’ve made, and join me in supporting these candidates today. Progressives can and must show up in record numbers for Democrats, and we can make the difference in ways that will keep candidates accountable and engaged with our priorities...but only if we vote and are vocal about our support! Here’s how I urge you to vote:

## Hi D. P.,
---
| | How many times is unfinished business never addressed? Do you feel lost at board meetings? Do you feel your voice is not being heard at meetings? Learn how to stand up for yourself and voice a concern or a motion. The application of parliamentary law is the best method yet devised to enable assemblies of any size, with due regard for every member's opinion, to arrive at the general will on the maximum number of questions of varying complexity in a minimum amount time and under all kinds of internal climate ranging from total harmony to hardened or impassioned division of opinion. Develop skills to be able to serve as a competent committee chairman or member. Develop skills to be able to function well as an organizational officer or member. Appreciate the importance of using a parliamentary authority in business and in your volunteer organizations. Assess the effectiveness of the meetings you conduct or attend.

Dear Friend,

Do you need help with your voting plan? At Keystone Progress, we want to make sure that everyone who can vote uses their power and that every one of their votes are counted.

That's why we created the KPEF How to Vote Guide [https://www.kpef.info/pa-voter-guide] . Because voting in Pennsylvania can be confusing, we put together answers to your questions.

KEYSTONE PROGRESS’ HOW TO VOTE GUIDE [https://www.kpef.info/pa-voter-guide]

Democracy is on the ballot. Our human rights are on the ballot. The futures of our families, our cities, state, and country, are on the ballot. None of us can afford to stay home this Nov. 8.

If you have questions about voting by mail or in person, our guide has answers [https://www.kpef.info/pa-voter-guide] . And remember, if you have any trouble voting, you can call 866-OUR-VOTE [tel:8666788683] . Please forward this to your family and friends so that they have the resources to make sure their voices are heard.

See you at the polls!

Laura

subject: A Marquette poll shows me trailing Ron Johnson by 1 point.
body:
Let me be clear:
Flipping Wisconsin's Senate seat this November is not a given. It's going to take an incredible amount of work to make it possible.
You can count on me to work as hard as possible to defeat Ron Johnson. But I cannot win this race alone.
I need you. A Marquette poll that came out recently shows me trailing by 1 point. Without you, we could lose.
So far more than 200,000 people have donated to this campaign. It means the world to me. But right now, I need you. And it’s not just me who needs you. All the people who have already donated, they need you, too. Because the only way we'll win is if we're in this together.

Thank you in advance for chipping in. Running for office, and especially a Senate seat against a Republican incumbent, isn’t easy. But the stakes make the challenge well worth it. Especially when we’re in it together.
Mandela

name: Shonda Rhimes
subject: We each can do something today, right now, to make the world suck less.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
I did not expect my daughters would grow up in a world where our ability to own our right to vote, own our uteruses, and own our freedom to love whomever we want would be in question.
#

Hey there, it’s Shonda Rhimes.
I’m reaching out because I want to ask you myself to support Cheri Beasley’s campaign for U.S. Senate in North Carolina.
Here’s the thing: Across the nation, we are seeing frankly horrific attacks on our fundamental rights and freedoms. I was born after the civil rights movement, and I was a toddler during the women's movement. I did not expect my daughters would grow up in a world where our ability to own our right to vote, own our uteruses, and own our freedom to love whomever we want would be in question.
The need to get people involved in democracy, and voting continues to be more urgent than ever. Our best hope to protect democracy and stop the attacks on our rights by a right-wing Supreme Court and Republican politicians is to expand the Senate majority.
Electing Cheri Beasley in North Carolina is our best chance to guarantee that we secure the decisive vote we need for change.
[**So I am asking you personally to make a donation, $3 or any amount you can, to Cheri Beasley’s campaign. This is a critical moment for us to show up and have her back.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-nov22.g3HOlK&refcode=em221103-1-MA&t=1&akid=2210%2E357359%2EO7ol7T)
Washington is often messy and corrupt. No, it is not as messy as Olivia Pope’s Washington. But still, there is so much gridlock and so much power concentrated with special interests that not enough gets done to help people.
Cheri gets that, and she’s running for Senate to try to change that, to shift the balance of power away from corporate interests and back toward the people.
It’s beautiful to witness her grit and fearlessness in this race. I think that anyone who is willing to stand up and put themselves on the line for what they believe in that strongly is beautiful. Activism is beautiful.
And see, that’s the thing. This isn’t just about Cheri. Her campaign is about all of us – every single person who shares our values and comes together to power this movement. We each can do something today, right now, to make the world suck less.
[**So please, if you can, consider making a donation to Cheri Beasley’s campaign to flip North Carolina. Every dollar will be invested immediately to win this fight for a brighter future where every person has a chance to thrive.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-nov22.g3HOlK&refcode=em221103-1-MA&t=2&akid=2210%2E357359%2EO7ol7T)

name: Tiara Parker, Pulse Survivor
subject: I Survived Pulse & Now I'm Fighting to Elect Gun Reform Candidates.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Pride Fund to End Gun Violence PAC and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Peter,

On June 12th, 2016, I was celebrating at Pulse Nightclub with my little cousin Akyra, who had just graduated from high school. But that night, our celebration turned into a nightmare when Akyra, 20 strangers, and I got as close as possible in a tiny bathroom stall and prayed that our lives would not be taken. I was shot, not only in my side, but I also sustained a grazed hip, burned back, and injuries to my right arm and legs. I was lucky to make it out alive, but I cannot say the same for everyone. My cousin, Akyra Murray, was tragically shot and murdered in the second deadliest mass shooting in American history.

That’s why I joined Pride Fund to End Gun Violence as a member of the Board of Advisors and why I am fighting for change to save lives from gun violence. The election is in 4 days, and its critical for the progress of our country -- the results from this year’s elections could ensure we keep a Democratic-led Congress that’s willing to stand up and pass gun safety laws that will save lives, or allow NRA-backed Republicans pushing the dangerous agenda of the NRA and standing in the way of progress on gun reform to take back power.

Will you stand with me in fighting back against the NRA by helping elect gun reform candidates through Pride Fund’s work?

WILL YOU DONATE TODAY? Donate here: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pf-tiaraelection22?refcode=2022&amount=25&recurring=yes

People like you help us win against the NRA’s massive spending in the elections process. Our work is almost entirely funded by grassroots supporters donating whatever they can to defeat Republicans who cast their votes for the gun lobby in Congress. Every dollar will help us reach more voters and make sure they vote in this critical election. Every donation, no matter the amount, will make these last few days of the election meaningful, to create safer communities across America for decades to come.

I was shot and wounded at Pulse, and my cousin was killed. Each day, I am terrified by that act of gun violence. Working together, we can change our nation’s gun laws, but to do that we have to change who is in Congress. Your donation will help Pride Fund in the fight to elect new leaders who champion gun reform.

In honor of my cousin Akyra, will you donate to our election efforts so we can fight to end gun violence and save lives? Donate here: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pf-tiaraelection22?refcode=2022&amount=25&recurring=yes

Tiara Parker

Pride Fund to End Gun Violence
Board of Advisors

DONATE- https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pf-tiaraelection22?refcode=2022&amount=25&recurring=yes

To help us grow this movement, will you please forward this email to 2 friends to get them involved?

Not subscribed to Pride Fund's emails? Sign up here. https://act.myngp.com/Forms/-7357247923588756736

name: Matthew Diemer
subject: Representation
body:
| |
---
Peter, What is a representative? **** Representatives come from every corner of America, symbolize a wide range of constituencies, and work to solve issues that may or may not be unique to their particular part of the country. **** In short: A representative does just that — represents. **** A representative should consider the whole of their district when voting on issues — not just the private interests that fund their campaign or those in their political corner. Understanding the district from top to bottom and right to left is paramount to true representation. **** At the outset of our American experiment, it wasn't believed that a representative from New York should or would legislate like a representative from Virginia. In the same way, a rep from OH shouldn't legislate on behalf of a man in Florida. **** Representatives are meant to bring their district to DC — the unique ideas and experiences from your area — and contribute those to the conversation of legislation. You'd build consensus and move things forward. **** This is what our system was envisioned to do. **** Now, however, we have the Ds and Rs, the red vs. blue, the left vs. right, legislating for all America regardless of its diversity or regional uniqueness. **** It's wrong, and we need to fix this. When you elect me to represent you, I promise this: **** ✅ I am not your leader. I am your representative. **** ✅ I will be the voice of our district in DC, not the factions that have emerged. **** ✅ I will put policy for ALL over politics. This is how we move to build a more perfect union. [The election is in just five days. clean_body: | | Peter, What is a representative? ** Representatives come from every corner of America, symbolize a wide range of constituencies, and work to solve issues that may or may not be unique to their particular part of the country. In short: A representative does just that — represents. A representative should consider the whole of their district when voting on issues — not just the private interests that fund their campaign or those in their political corner. Understanding the district from top to bottom and right to left is paramount to true representation. At the outset of our American experiment, it wasn't believed that a representative from New York should or would legislate like a representative from Virginia. In the same way, a rep from OH shouldn't legislate on behalf of a man in Florida. Representatives are meant to bring their district to DC — the unique ideas and experiences from your area — and contribute those to the conversation of legislation. You'd build consensus and move things forward. This is what our system was envisioned to do. Now, however, we have the Ds and Rs, the red vs. blue, the left vs. right, legislating for all America regardless of its diversity or regional uniqueness. It's wrong, and we need to fix this. When you elect me to represent you, I promise this: ✅ I am not your leader. I am your representative. ✅ I will be the voice of our district in DC, not the factions that have emerged. ** ✅ I will put policy for ALL over politics. This is how we move to build a more perfect union. I listen. I’ve listened to the moms in Erie standing next to their minivans, telling me about how rising costs were making them wonder whether or not they were going to be able to take their kids to the activities that they wanted to go to. I talked to the mom in a rural community living right next to a polluted area, worried that when she bathed her child that the water coming out of the tap wasn’t clean. I listened to people in communities that oftentimes felt ignored and forgotten. The person who called the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania when the pandemic hit and they lost their job, and couldn't even get their calls returned. I stood alongside the grandma in Lawrence County, who quite literally grabbed me by the lapels and pulled me into her face and said do not let us go back to what it was like before _Roe_. The countless people who have stopped me along the way and just wondered whether or not our democracy was going to get through this. I have listened and I have heard those concerns, and I'm running to be your Governor not just to win an election, but to meet this moment, to address that worry, and to move Pennsylvania forward. **[That's why I'm running to be your Governor. [1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

The journey to this moment has been a long one,
Derek.

But before I tell you more, I need your help in the final stretch of this
race.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221103_B1_SYAInstagram_S1_T1_SYA_30open_RS&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=16958%2E1862389%2EpCQ8-X ]Early voting ends tomorrow and my team can’t fall short between now and
Election Day. Will you chip in $5 right now to help fuel
our last stretch of the campaign? Every vote counts in this election — and
so does every contribution.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221103_B1_SYAInstagram_S1_T1_SYA_30open_RS&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=16958%2E1862389%2EpCQ8-X ]DONATE

Derek, I began
this journey in June 2017, when I stood in Chehaw Park in Albany to
announce my candidacy for governor. I ran for 16 months. By the end of the
campaign, our team had mobilized the most diverse coalition Georgia had
ever seen before.

Even as the odds mounted against us, and Republicans worked hard to
decrease access to voting, we fought to the very end. With hope. With
determination.

But I didn’t get the job in 2018.

But I didn’t quit, I kept working from Georgians. I changed my how but
never lost what drives me. And I decided to try again because I know
Georgia can be extraordinary if we truly invest in our people. I believe
in meeting people where they are, not where you want them to be. I believe
that if we want people to turn out, we have to show that it is worth the
pain of hope.

But it’s not about 2018, 2020 or 2021 anymore. This year, we face a
once-in-a-generation opportunity to make unprecedented progress both today
and tomorrow for our families. We look to the future and imagine the
incredible story that we can write for ourselves and for our families — if
we have a governor who sees all of us.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221103_B1_SYAInstagram_S1_T1_SYA_30open_RS&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=16958%2E1862389%2EpCQ8-X ]That’s why I know it’s worth it to fight. To try again. To do
everything we can to win. So, that’s why I ask,
Derek. Will you do everything
in your power to help us get voters to the polls in these final days and
win? $25 — or even $5 — will make a lasting
difference in this final stretch.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221103_B1_SYAInstagram_S1_T1_SYA_30open_RS&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=16958%2E1862389%2EpCQ8-X ]DONATE

This time, let’s get it done.

— Stacey

Peter,

We’re looking at my opponent’s October fundraising numbers and **she’s raising more money than any of us every expected.** In October, she raised nearly $200,000 online. Quite honestly, **I didn’t think donors gave money to socialists, but apparently, they do**.

**My campaign’s average donation in October was $32.** Thanks to out of state, deep-pocketed donors that will literally do anything to keep me from winning this race, my opponent’s average donation was $70 - **nearly $40 higher than my own.**

There are only a few days left to turn the tide, so I'm asking for your support today.

body:
Don't be silent in this election. We need your vote. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/9268619f9d95/test-email-meet-mike-ford-the-democrat-running-in-ga-2407?e=e60663a86e)

# Your Vote is your Voice.
Don’t be silent. Don’t sit on the sidelines. We need you to join us + vote.
[](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=211e054f0b&e=e60663a86e)
**Folks, we’re in the home stretch.****I ’m Mike Ford, the Democrat running for US Congress in GA-09.** It’s less than a week until election day and I’m working hard to pull off an epic upset to unseat extremist Republican incumbent, Rep Andrew Clyde, but I still need your help.We need Democrats to come out of the woodwork. Independents to get off the fence. Republicans to put country over party. The disengaged + disinterested to show up and help save our nation. I welcome everyone, Democrats, Independents, and Republicans to join me in our collective fight to defend our democracy, restore women’s full reproductive rights and autonomy over their own bodies, protect our voting rights, defend Social Security and Medicare, honor our Veterans, and eject divisive right-wing extremism from our US House of Representatives.I encourage each of you to talk to your family, friends, neighbors, co-workers and help them see what is at stake this election; our very Democracy that make us Americans. Thank you for your support and your vote.With Sincere Gratitude,
Mike Ford[**mike4georgia.com**](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=a7a5ed0886&e=e60663a86e)
|
---
**My Opponent, Rep Andrew Clyde is one of the Worst in Congress at Downplaying Right-Wing Political Violence****Violence in politics is never, ever acceptable.** It’s deeply wrong and should be strongly denounced by all political leaders. When the violence is done by someone on behalf of a political party, it is the duty of the leaders of that party to denounce it. There is nothing funny about the vicious attempted murder of Speaker Pelosi's husband. He is still hospitalized and at 82 years old a fractured skull is an injury he will likely never fully recover from. Those on the right, joking about and mocking this heinous crime are morally repugnant. The fact that elected Republicans aren’t all condemning the violence but rather some are even joining in, mocking the vicious attack, is even worse. The silence of the vast majority of elected Republican leaders is tacit approval of right-wing political violence. As an elected leader in Congress, every member should immediately. publicly condemn a violent murder attempt on the spouse of a fellow member of Congress. It’s basic decency and humanity which unfortunately Republicans are proving they lack. As awful as this attack and response is, unfortunately we shouldn’t be surprised by the silence of my opponent who made a national name for himself, gaslighting all Americans by downplaying the violent, deadly right-wing Jan 6th insurrection on our nation’s Capitol as a “normal tourist visit.” It proves that he is unfit to serve as a leader and must be voted out. **It’s time to vote out Republicans, not just in GA-09 but in every district.**
|
---
**Hurry! Time is running out to vote!****Early voting is still happening in Georgia through Nov 4th!** You never know if bad weather, car trouble, or a family/work emergency will prevent you from voting on Election Day so don’t delay, please vote early. **Election Day is Tuesday, Nov 8.** Democracy is not a spectator sport, as citizens of the United States of America, it is our civic duty to vote. To preview your full ballot of all candidates + ballot initiatives, simply go to [**www.ballotpedia.org**](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=e9e0e71ba0&e=e60663a86e) click on “2022 Elections” then click on “Preview My Ballot” then enter your address. When voting, don’t stop at the top, vote blue the entire ballot.
**A Word of Thanks + Gratitude****I want to take a moment to say thank you to everyone who has donated to my campaign and who has supported my campaign in any manner.** To all the folks who have followed and liked me on social media, to those who have attended events, who mailed postcards, who put out yard signs, and more, thank you for all you have done. I’m truly appreciative of all your ongoing support! Let’s keep up the momentum and finish this race to the end. Less than a week to go and we are still fighting for every vote.
|

| | Peter —

I’ve served my country in the Navy, at NASA, and now in the Senate.

No matter where I’ve been or what I was doing, I’ve always used science, data, and facts to make tough decisions.

And right now, the facts tell me that we’re in trouble.

I didn’t spend more than 54 days in space observing the damage climate change is wreaking on our planet just for far-right extremists to deny the truth and refuse to take action. I think our leaders should follow the facts, listen to the science, and act decisively — **_[will you split a donation of $25 between my campaign and the Democratic Party of Georgia if you agree?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53945937/376986880/388187220?refcode=20221103.3_MK_11Q&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZDg0ODZmOC04YjViLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rZo__i6gi2yx2y4KEz1oISr29_hJE7KBmIBYOoCl9dk=)_**

Our leaders should respect the will of the voters and free and fair elections — **_[if you agree, will you split a $25 donation between my campaign and the Democratic Party of Georgia?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53945938/376986881/388187220?refcode=20221103.3_MK_11Q&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZDg0ODZmOC04YjViLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rZo__i6gi2yx2y4KEz1oISr29_hJE7KBmIBYOoCl9dk=)_**

Science, data, and facts have helped me solve some of the most difficult challenges in my life. And I think we need more members of Congress who are willing to put politics aside and do the same.

| My Fellow Nevadans, The Midterm Election is in**5 days** , and your voice is more critical than ever. On Tuesday, we’ll change the trajectory of Nevada. Adam Laxalt has my vote, let me tell you why: My husband Kenny C. Guinn served two terms as Governor of Nevada. He was a successful businessman and champion of education as a teacher, administrator, and as our governor. Throughout Kenny's life, driven by his love for Nevada, he served his community and state by dedicating a tremendous amount of effort and time to helping the least fortunate among us. l'm supporting Adam Laxalt because he has the same love for Nevada that my husband did. Adam was born in Reno, served our nation in the Navy and in Iraq, and, as our Attorney General, he fought for Nevada's most vulnerable citizens, such as victims of human trafficking and sexual assault. Active members of the military, veterans and their families, and Nevada's senior citizens are better served because of the actions and efforts of Adam Laxalt. I wholeheartedly endorse Adam Laxalt for U.S. Senate. Adam's principles, compassion, and work ethic best exemplify the legacy that my husband demonstrated throughout his life, and I know he'll carry these forward to the U.S. Senate. Your vote is crucial in this fight to save Nevada. It’s up to us to unite and get out the vote for Adam Laxalt. If we sit on the sidelines, out-of-touch Democrats will continue to destroy our country, our economy, and our communities. We can't let that happen. Please, make sure that you have a plan to vote. Whether it’s early in-person or in-person on Election Day, we must take action to elect Adam Laxalt as our next U.S. Senator. There’s too much on the line to rely on others. _We must take individual action._ Find your polling location here: [https://www.nvsos.gov/sos/elections/election-information/2022-election-information/voting-locations](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=fb44a26fdf&e=018ab83301) **Please, make sure that you have a plan to vote and join me in helping elect Adam Laxalt as our next U.S. Senator.**
Regards and Best Wishes, Dema Guinn

Derek,
We already knew that Dr. Oz was spending million$ to defeat John Fetterman and buy PA’s U.S. Senate seat this year.
But a new report from the _Philadelphia Inquirer_ says Oz has personally spent nearly $27 MILLION on his Senate campaign — **more than the entire base salary of Phillies star Bryce Harper.** 🤯
That’s a LOT of money, Derek. And over these next five days, you can bet Oz will keep spending _whatever_ it takes to close the gap in this neck-and-neck race, take the lead, and win this race.
**John doesn’t have million$ to self-fund this campaign. name: Ron Johnson
subject: a personal plea
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks.

|
---
| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z26gfegdg7p90gvvr9dm8uddagjpi81tlj5cfgvo_rp22sh2s8i66or7clg6co76c1h2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

| | **Public safety has become a top priority for voters, not just here in Northwest Washington but nationally, which is why my Congressional colleagues and I have taken meaningful action:** → We passed the first gun violence prevention bill in decades. The bipartisan bill closes the boyfriend loophole, toughens background checks, and provides local governments with the means to administer red flag laws. → The American Rescue Plan included $10 billion to put more police officers on the streets, which is the single largest federal investment in state and local law enforcement in history. → We reauthorized and expanded the Violence Against Women Act. I am especially proud that this bill also passed on a bipartisan basis. These common-sense measures represent only a few critical steps we can take to reduce crime, reduce gun violence, and save lives. There is still more to do, of course, including sending the Invest to Protect Act to the president's desk, which provides increased funding to local and tribal police departments. The House passed it – along with a package of other public safety bills – to the Senate this past summer. In the next term, I am hopeful we can find bipartisan agreement on all of them and pass them into law. Whether it is crime, the economy, or any other issue, I will always work hard to ensure you and your family live in a safe and prosperous community. **That is my core duty as your Representative.** I guess [my Tweet](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/15187?t=2&akid=3568%2E2526796%2ESxvbvR) making fun of Elon Musk’s silly little plan to charge people $8/month for Twitter verification and “priority placement” made him mad because he decided to Tweet a screenshot of our campaign store as some kind of “gotcha” that other people pay money for goods in the world.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/15186?utm_source=em20221103-3568&t=3&akid=3568%2E2526796%2ESxvbvR)
Here’s the thing: **unlike Elon Musk, we support union work.** All of our merchandise is made in the USA by union workers. In fact, all the workers on our campaign are unionized. They make a living wage, have full healthcare and other benefits like childcare stipends, and aren’t subject to racist treatment in their workplaces.
**Not to mention that _we do things_ for society with the resources that are entrusted to us.** All proceeds go toward community organizing – providing free, online homework help to kids in underserved communities with our Homework Helpers program.
Meanwhile, billionaires pocket the change. Whenever you have one person that has amassed that much wealth – usually off the backs of underpaying working people and exploiting them and/or the planet – that does not help society, in fact it hurts society.
So this is just your daily reminder that indeed, every billionaire is a policy failure in a country that does not guarantee health care and has enormous amounts of poverty.
[So please, check out our shop and support our workers and our communities.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/9251?utm_source=em20221103-3568&t=4&akid=3568%2E2526796%2ESxvbvR)
I’m proud that Team AOC honors and respects working people. Elon should try it sometime.
Thanks for reading.
Alexandria

#
**My Fellow Patriot,**

**Joe Biden claims that he now INHERITED the economic crisis of his own making! How could he lie about two consecutive quarters of GDP decline? WE’RE IN A RECESSION! **
**He can lie all he wants; we know the facts:** **Under Trump, inflation was at 1.4%, and gas prices were at $2.39/gal. ** **Today, under Biden, inflation is at 8.2%, and gas prices are at $3.82/gal.** **This is why we need conservatives like me in Congress to RESTORE fiscal responsibility and common sense to Washington by voting out the racist lunatics!**
#

[**Americans are waking up the lies! Chip in NOW - $25, $50, $100!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=5f8a7bdbb2&e=3cd8121505)

**My name is Leon Benjamin, and I’m running for Congress as a Conservative Republican... because I’m sick of what the far Left has done to my community and to American families. I’m a husband, father, and pastor. I owe it to my congregation and my family to build a better future. These days we need to fight for them even to have a future!**
[ ](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=b5c4247eb9&e=3cd8121505)[**Help me beat the special interests and the Soros money, and support our list of endorsed candidates- $50, $150, $250!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=d2db2a9810&e=3cd8121505)
**I’m a Navy Combat Veteran, Small Business Owner, and Senior Pastor and Bishop at my church. I even helped create President Trump’s Faith-Based Initiative back in 2016.**

**I’m up against a proxy-voting DC sellout who sells out Christianity and the black community at every SECOND! My opponent VOTED FOR inflation! VOTED FOR the border crisis! VOTED FOR more crime! VOTED FOR election overhaul! Unlike him, I WILL SERVE MY COMMUNITY!** [**SUPPORT BLACK CONSERVATIVE CANDIDATES!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=6ecc905a47&e=3cd8121505) **If the Left really cared about the Black community, as President Trump does, then we would have seen greater action decades ago as we saw in the last administration. It’s time the Left learned that conservative principles and conservative values ARE BLACK VALUES.

BLM and Antifa are more focused on destroying our communities and burning them down than fighting issues affecting us like inflation, high gas prices, or higher consumer prices. They are hateful, destructive, and out of touch. ** [**DONATE TO TAKE BACK THE HOUSE!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=5659ac30f9&e=3cd8121505) **My opponent is a radical leftist who’s voted to strip law-abiding Americans, voted for the election overthrow HR-1, gun control, socialism, mass amnesty, and so much more. His actions to trample our constitution, destroy American values and suppress We The People’s voice is unacceptable.

I appreciate your support; my team said I need to come up with $15,000 by the end of this campaign to help secure our media and radio slots to win the general. **
[**DONATE NOW!**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=4fbcc3fb87&e=3cd8121505) [**$25**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=0644ca093b&e=3cd8121505)
[**$50**](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=c02fd4d4c3&e=3cd8121505)
**[$75](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=1aad19258b&e=3cd8121505)**
**[$100](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=80a70525e8&e=3cd8121505)**
**God bless you, your families, and God bless America. The country we know, love, and must protect. ** **Your Friend in Christ,**

Leon Benjamin [****](https://benjamin4congress.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bf85a44dd108635a55466e64b&id=3b3d37d2fd&e=3cd8121505)

Dear Fellow Tennesseans,
I’m reaching out to you today about the election for Governor of our great state taking place in just one week!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/agtn [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/agtn]
The election happening next week is about so much more than just names on a ballot—you have the power to make a choice to chart a new direction for our state. I’ve had the opportunity to get to know Dr. Jason Brantley Martin throughout his time on the campaign, and I think he is the right leader to put us back on the right track and take us forward. Whether in underserved communities, in healthcare, or as a father and husband, he has served Tennessee, and we would be lucky to have him as our next governor. It is my honor to endorse him and ask you to make a plan to do the same my casting your vote for him next Tuesday.
Every single vote matters, and the people you vote for put policies in place that affect you on a daily basis. I implore you to not sit on the sidelines, but to make your voice heard. Vote for responsible economic policies; vote for policies that address the climate crisis; vote for democracy; vote for equality; vote for women’s reproductive rights; vote for safety and progress.
Join me in voting for Dr. Jason Brantley Martin. Join me in the fight for change!
Sincerely,
Al Gore

Hi everyone,

John Lira's race is one of the most competitive Congressional races in the state, and TX-23 needs a better representative than Tony Gonzales.

John is fighting for working communities, to bring justice to Uvalde's families, and to secure a better future for the next generation of Texans.

Tony Gonzales is dividing our communities, leaving our children in danger, and taking money from big corporate donors while leaving working families in the dark.

The choice in this race couldn’t be clearer. And our internal polling shows that if we can spread John’s message to enough voters, he can win big.
Chip in now to help John reach thousands of voters over the next 5 days → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lira?refcode=EM_FR_221103Dem_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_logo&amount=10]

Republicans see the writing on the wall in TX-23, and they’re scared. They’re pouring untold amounts of dark money into this race because they know that we can win. With less than a week until Election Day, I have no doubt GOP mega-donors will spend whatever it takes to keep control of this seat.

But we can’t let that stop us. This election is a critical moment — not only for our state but for our country. So much is at stake, and we need a groundswell of grassroots contributions to overcome the Republican investment in this race. So, we’re counting on you.

Will you join me in supporting John and chip in $10 or anything you can to power John’s fight to the finish line?
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lira?refcode=EM_FR_221103Dem_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_logo&amount=10]

The last time this seat was up, just 3 points determined the winner. And we know that John can close that gap if he can spread his message of progress and opportunity to enough voters. Tony’s support is shrinking, while John’s momentum can only grow.

If we work together, we can flip this seat, deliver for the families of TX-23, and send a champion for working Texans to Congress. Let’s get it done.

Adelante,

Gilberto Hinojosa
Chair, Texas Democratic Party

Peter, In just a moment, I’m going to kindly ask for your support in the home stretch of this election, because I’m ready to get to Congress and hold MAGA Republicans accountable. But first, I want to tell you about what prepared me for this fight. I’ve spent my life holding the powerful accountable and protecting our democracy. Two years ago, I served as the Democrats’ Lead Counsel during Donald Trump’s first impeachment investigation. We proved that a corrupt president had abused the power of his office to undermine our democratic process in a bid to stay in power — something we’d see happen again in horrific fashion after he lost the 2020 election. **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53969300/377073396/-661594589?refcode=AU_DSG_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20221103_PM1_V1_S1_VSP&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZTZhMWZhMy1iOTViLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pCNApoUIe9u_CBRaZCZzNTmAQA7pah_TwghEoAayga4=)** Before that, I spent a decade serving as Assistant United States Attorney in the Southern District of New York. I took on some of the biggest and most consequential cases: Prosecuting violent gangs and gun trafficking, mafia bosses and Russian organized crime, and landmark insider trading and major corporate fraud cases. **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53969301/377073397/-661594589?refcode=AU_DSG_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20221103_PM1_V1_S1_VSP&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZTZhMWZhMy1iOTViLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pCNApoUIe9u_CBRaZCZzNTmAQA7pah_TwghEoAayga4=)** Peter, the Republican party is growing more extreme by the day. But first, I want to tell you about what prepared me for this fight. I’ve spent my life holding the powerful accountable and protecting our democracy. Two years ago, I served as the Democrats’ Lead Counsel during Donald Trump’s first impeachment investigation. We proved that a corrupt president had abused the power of his office to undermine our democratic process in a bid to stay in power — something we’d see happen again in horrific fashion after he lost the 2020 election. = Before that, I spent a decade serving as Assistant United States Attorney in the Southern District of New York. I took on some of the biggest and most consequential cases: Prosecuting violent gangs and gun trafficking, mafia bosses and Russian organized crime, and landmark insider trading and major corporate fraud cases. = Peter, the Republican party is growing more extreme by the day. After Donald Trump sent a mob to attack our democracy on January 6th, they embraced his Big Lie — and they’ve promised to shut down the House Select Committee investigation if they flip the House. The threat to the very foundation of our democracy is real and growing. This moment demands leaders who will step up to the plate and get the job done — and I’m ready to do just that. So Peter, please chip in any amount to help send me to Washington. With just 5 days left in this election, every dollar helps. | Dear Peter,We know that today's world does NOT reward humility or integrity very often. We see less and less of it it seems. But then, a man like Wayne Hoffman of <https://idahofreedom.org/> comes along and slashes all our predetermined expectations.What you're about to read is simply the best example of intellectual honesty you're likely to find anywhere. I know you're going to be as moved and impressed with Wayne as I am._Email from_ _Wayne Hoffman_ _Several times a month, someone either writes in the newspaper or online things about me, the Idaho Freedom Foundation, or Idaho Freedom Action that just aren't true. Things like:__We get our funding from secret, out-of-state, "dark money" sources. (not true)__We're an extension of the Libertarian Party. (nope)__We were part of an effort to "dox" police officers and protest at their homes. (pure garbage)__The one that inspired yesterday's email: Idaho Freedom Foundation endorsed Ammon Bundy for governor. (No, it was Idaho Freedom PAC)__There are probably several more lies told about me, the IFF, IFA, and IFP, but these are the ones that I hear all the time in one form or another. Sometimes, they are repeated innocently enough. But a lie repeated often seemingly becomes the truth.__Such is the case with my email yesterday. I repeated allegations about Ammon Bundy that turns out aren't true, but because I've heard them so many times, I was certain that I was right. So now I must correct the record.__No: Ammon Bundy did not "join" Black Lives Matter. He simply expressed empathy for the stated theme of ending police brutality, of which there is some overlap with some of the people involved in BLM protests.__And no: Ammon Bundy was not "zip tied" to a chair and wheeled out of the Capitol in conjunction with a protest there. He was forcibly removed from the Statehouse while seated in a chair, but not the way I described it.__I was so certain that I was right in my recollections -- and even talked about it with friends who described the same erroneous "facts" in perfect synchronized detail -- that I didn't feel I needed to bother to reexamine the evidence for myself. The reasons why don't matter. __We own our mistakes, and I do mine. It is entirely my fault for not independently verifying what I had recalled.__I apologize for the errors in the last email. All of this shows that we must be vigilant in tracking down our own information and double-checking everything as we weigh matters of public policy and elections. Do not take the words of the press or the people who regurgitate what they've read or heard to be true. Don't rely on memory. Don't trust what you've heard said or recalled reading about certain candidates. Don't believe the leftist media or the trolls on Twitter or other social media.__Do your own research. Be a smart voter. Take your time. Be informed, and then cast your vote.__These are difficult times for all of us. We must be on guard, and we have to call out inaccuracies whenever we encounter them, speak boldly, and speak the truth. Please consider helping us in our efforts to promote a free society and abandon the socialist policies that are destroying America._
Thanks Wayne. It takes a real man to openly correct a mistake. I hope that I will be able to do so in all that I do. Honor to you, and great thanks. You represent Idaho the way it should be.Sincerely,Ammon BundyP.S. More than anything else the reason you should vote for me is because of what I am planning on doing in Idaho. Please go to my Keep Idaho IDAHO plan, get informed and SHARE IT with your family, friends and contacts. We are winning and your help is needed to seal the deal on November 8th. Click here to go to my Keep Idaho IDAHO plan: <https://www.votebundy.com/about/keep-idaho-idaho-plan/>P.S.S. Not sure that P.S.S. is a real thing but I wanted you to know that I will be holding a FINAL Virtual Q&A on Monday (7th) at 7pm MST. I will be the last time people can ask me questions before the election. I will answer any question you have as long as it is appropriate. Please register to the Virtual Q&A here: <https://www.votebundy.com/campaign-events/virtual-townhall/>

| | | | | **Cliff’s Note:** **Per _CBS News_ polling, "If November’s election sees a big turnout of young voters and voters of color...the Battleground Tracker predicts Democrats hold onto the majority by a single seat..." If not, we lose 10-15 seats, and the House, where Marjorie Taylor Greene will promptly push for Joe Biden's impeachment. _We can't let this happen_. Like the Kansas abortion referendum, younger voters will determine if it does. Please keep this in mind as you read Mark Hamill's urgent plea below to support _Voters of Tomorrow_ , as they register every last voter in states like Colorado--where Lauren Boebert's in danger of losing her seat--that allow voter registration through Election Day. ** [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3968997b-e980-4586-8424-e855a9f4f115/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Dear Peter, **Voters of Tomorrow, has a simple plan: Educate, register, and mobilize young voters so they can have a voice in the next election. Younger voters HAVE ALREADY MADE THE DIFFERENCE THIS ELECTION. The record-breaking turnout among younger voters and women in Kansas is credited with destroying a Death Star in Kansas, the referendum attempting to ban all abortion. With its defeat by a whopping 18%, I think we can successfully say that Death Star was destroyed.** **_But if we know anything about Death Stars--and the Right Wing in this country--they're always building more._** I'm not saying any of this to be dramatic, I save that for onscreen. This is for real. They're trying to take away our rights--to choose, whom to love, what books our kids read, the safety of our children inside schools and outside in our climate--RIGHT NOW. Without high turnout from young voters, the fate of our future will be sealed. **_So with the 2022 midterm election only 5 days away, Voters of Tomorrow's voter registration efforts are more important than ever. They will register every last voter, which in some states continues right up through election day._** Registering one new voter costs $4.38, and they're still hoping to register more than 5,000 new voters by the election - that’s $21,900! [**So today, I'm asking you to chip in $22 to help fund their General Election Fund so they can ramp up voter registration efforts. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Democrats are afraid they are about to lose the governor’s race and they’re desperately engaging in underhanded tactics to try and trick Kansans into giving Gov. Laura Kelly four more years, despite all her failures in the first four.| | |
---
| | **ICYMI:****Democrats fund Dennis Pyle campaign to split conservatives ** **By Susan Wagle**[ _November 3, 2022, The Wichita Eagle_](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=b426b6c7651443d9b71e177dc894729f&_e=t00NZ2kH5WMF2Ss_-1z94TB7QoTmXx5NrsjIKUlO5YPCN_SFpXCdZwNVcX8LdmaiC1rYAVdTTEESB-M77Ygs7bS0CKAcWQ6yiT_vgPvKF8GHdqgl-94aFFiQl5BaylDDFkesjOuQJtvsm6ubWqLldTqmZa6P1ZWAWxEgSJGSDcUr3V5jQfoQqB0gW-dL6xvDaNr0SKm-0_edpUW1ZTKxBmbZqEIrGawoLU0DgC2REYPaFdTL7TJ3_crXpwxPXcq4) Democrats are afraid they are about to lose the governor’s race and they’re desperately engaging in underhanded tactics to try and trick Kansans into giving Gov. Laura Kelly four more years, despite all her failures in the first four.
News reports have surfaced this week that an organization called “American Center” has been sending mail pieces and buying radio ads in the Kansas governor’s race to attack our Republican nominee, Derek Schmidt, and benefit Sen. Dennis Pyle, an independent candidate on the ballot.
Truth is, “American Center” is a Democrat front group that shares an office with Perkins Coie, the controversial Washington D.C. law firm used by Hillary Clinton in the 2016 election and one that has serviced many Democrats over the years. The organization is also using a well-known Democrat media buying firm to place its radio ads.

It’s clear as day what’s happening here. Seeing her chances at re-election slipping away, Kelly and her allies have calculated the only way they can win is trick enough conservative Kansans to throw away their vote on Tuesday.
Make no mistake: a vote for any other candidate than Derek Schmidt is a vote for Laura Kelly.

Kansas conservatives curious about the mail and radio advertisements must consider the source of the information. Hillary Clinton’s law firm in Washington does not have Kansas’ best interests at heart. Washington Democrats propping up a spoiler do not want to advance our conservative movement.
Derek Schmidt does. I’ve known Derek for a long time, and he’s a rock solid fighter who has been a great attorney general for our state. He’s endorsed by former President Donald Trump, former Secretary of State Mike Pompeo, and many others across the America First movement who know he will be an incredible governor.

These Democrat-funded attacks focus on the issue of immigration. I would ask who you trust more on immigration - Donald Trump or the party of Joe Biden, Hillary Clinton, and Laura Kelly that has flung our borders wide open.
Trump wants you to vote for Derek. The Democrats don’t — that tells you about all you need to know.
But that’s not all. Derek has been endorsed by the National Border Patrol Council, the union that represents the very Customs and Border Protection agents doing the Lord’s work patrolling our border every day and night keeping us safe. They have Derek’s back because they know he understands our Southern Border and Joe Biden abandoning his duty to protect it has invited crime and deadly drugs, like fentanyl, into our communities.

Every day, a Kansan dies from fentanyl poisoning. Derek has the experience fighting drug abuse and crime to be a great law and order governor. He certainly won’t dismiss the issue as “political games” like Laura Kelly.
Since the day this independent candidate got into the governor’s race, he’s admitted that his intention is to split the conservative vote. Shrewd political operators knew he would receive support from Democrats, because after all, they were the ones who helped him get the petition signatures required to get on the ballot in the first place. It’s sad and desperate that liberals would resort to these kinds of dirty tricks. It’s a shame the candidate is playing along.
It’s our job as conservatives to send them all a message. We do it by voting for Derek Schmidt to be our next Kansas governor. I will be and I hope you do too.

[Click here to read the whole piece in _The_ _Wichita Eagle. _](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=b426b6c7651443d9b71e177dc894729f&_e=t00NZ2kH5WMF2Ss_-1z94TB7QoTmXx5NrsjIKUlO5YPCN_SFpXCdZwNVcX8LdmaiC1rYAVdTTEESB-M77Ygs7bS0CKAcWQ6yiT_vgPvKF8Hcn9mRDJl8z2qA-9VVzzJhNmXw_LRlsKvwg64OX0NxeaIXJozVzglMPyHmzuvkdQ-laD-bBLEIWmYGzZeyj34YWGWkbxIDVKzxQxgVcuRQp7UqnxjqWmBrQ2zg0RNZZGMZraxBNOFpwerjkY7aWXi7) ###

body:
Every time our campaign has set an ambitious goal, our volunteers have risen to the challenge.

| Not interested? [Unsubscribe here](https://www.doug4gov.com/unsubscribe?e=22fbcd4cc2070ad1eddfbcb62da93ed4&utm_source=dougmastriano&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=poll_greeters_dm&n=1).

[ ](?utm_content=logo&) Peter -- Words cannot express the deep appreciation Rebbie and I have for all the work you have done for our campaign. This grassroots movement is nothing like this state has ever seen before. Every time our campaign has set an ambitious goal, our volunteers have risen to the challenge. Rebbie and I are calling on you, once again, to help us cross the finish line as winners on November 8th. Ensuring we have adequate coverage at all key precincts, throughout the state, will help ensure our victory. Recent studies have shown that as many as 10% of voters are still undecided when they go to cast their vote on Election Day. In the 2019 Virginia Gubernatorial race, Glenn Youngkin’s poll greeters covered over 90% of the precincts in Virginia. That was key to his victory in a very close race. Here in PA, we want to ensure that the last person a voter talks to before they go into their polling place is a passionate Mastriano supporter. I`m calling on you to sign up as a poll greeter, in your county, for November 8th. We can’t do this without you! Please contact Becky@doug4gov.com and Joshking@doug4gov.com to sign up and they will provide you with next steps. Onward to victory, Douglas V. Mastriano Friends of Doug Mastriano

PeterIn the final days of this election, there is nothing more important than getting our message to every single voter. With a state as big as ours, much of that comes down to digital advertisements. Facebook knows that and that is why they have denied to now censor our campaign ads.Yes, my campaign commercial showing criminal activity that was caught on camera & shown on TV has been flagged by Facebook as too “sensitive” and has been blocked. Another example of Big Tech interfering with the election to stop people from seeing the harm that Democrats are doing.
[](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=d5ace1a90b&e=fdefed58de)
I’m going to point out the obvious - if they weren’t afraid of our campaign they wouldn’t be censoring our message. Clearly, we’re making waves. With this, though, we need to QUICKLY re-strategize to get this ad out to the people before the 8th of November.So, I’m asking you **urgently** to chip in today - with just four days left until this race will be decided. We need to get this ad out on other social media platforms and we need to do so now. With our race being so close to the finish line, almost every dollar of our budget is already allocated to other places. We need you right now - any bit helps - so that we can get to every voter in the next four days.**Can I count on your urgent support so that we can get our closing argument out to every voter despite the big tech censorship?**

body:
My name is Stacey Yvonne Abrams and I’m running to be the next governor of the great state of Georgia.

The journey to this moment has been a long one, Derek. **But before I tell you more, I need your help in the final stretch of this race.** **[Election Day is in less than 5 days and my team can’t fall short between now and November 8. Will you split a donation right now between Josh Shapiro and me to help fuel our campaigns? Every vote counts in this election — and so does every contribution.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53970179/377076464/221824738?refcode=email_110322_abrams_allactive&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=a39cbf7e-ba5b-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzljYmY3ZS1iYTViLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UNVx-gPrToh3XFyRqXGurxw2m3Ipgn1ORU93I4LwCMo=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [Donate $5 →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53970180/377076465/221824738?refcode=email_110322_abrams_allactive&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&express_lane=true&refcode2=a39cbf7e-ba5b-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzljYmY3ZS1iYTViLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UNVx-gPrToh3XFyRqXGurxw2m3Ipgn1ORU93I4LwCMo=)
