Derek, I began this journey in June 2017, when I stood in Chehaw Park in Albany to announce my candidacy for governor. I ran for 16 months. By the end of the campaign, our team had mobilized the most diverse coalition Georgia had ever seen before.
**Even as the odds mounted against us, and Republicans worked hard to decrease access to voting, we fought to the very end. With hope. With determination.**
But I didn’t get the job in 2018.
But I didn’t quit, I kept working for Georgians. I changed my how but never lost what drives me. And I decided to try again because I know Georgia can be extraordinary if we truly invest in our people. I believe in meeting people where they are, not where you want them to be. I believe that if we want people to turn out, we have to show that it is worth the pain of hope.
**But it’s not about 2018, 2020 or 2021 anymore. This year, we face a once-in-a-generation opportunity to make unprecedented progress both today and tomorrow for our families. We look to the future and imagine the incredible story we can write for ourselves and our families — if we have a governor who sees all of us.**
**[That’s why I know it’s worth it to fight. To try again. To do everything we can to win. So, that’s why I ask, Derek. Will you do everything you can to help us get voters to the polls in 5 days and win? Splitting a donation of any amount between my campaign and Josh Shapiro's will make a lasting difference in this final stretch.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53970181/377076466/221824738?refcode=email_110322_abrams_allactive&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=a39cbf7e-ba5b-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzljYmY3ZS1iYTViLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UNVx-gPrToh3XFyRqXGurxw2m3Ipgn1ORU93I4LwCMo=)**
This time, let’s get it done.
— Stacey

I fought some of the most dangerous terrorists in the world in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia.

It was a huge sacrifice, Peter. I missed birthdays, holidays, and milestones.

**But I never doubted my choice to serve - because I knew my service was keeping my children safe and preserving the American Dream for their generation.**

clean_body: | | | Peter, I spent 25 years serving alongside special forces and SEAL team operators in the United States Navy. I fought some of the most dangerous terrorists in the world in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia. It was a huge sacrifice, Peter. I missed birthdays, holidays, and milestones. But I never doubted my choice to serve - because I knew my service was keeping my children safe and preserving the American Dream for their generation. My time in the Navy may be over, but my call to serve our country is just as strong. Now, I’m ready to serve in a different way: as your Representative in Congress. Right now, there’s a RECORD LOW number of veterans in Congress, Peter. That’s a problem. America’s veterans know what it’s like to sacrifice in a way that career politicians never will. And we’re not going to abandon the values we put our lives on the line for for big lobbyist dollars or fame. I’m ready to make America’s veterans proud and be the leader our great country deserves in Congress, but I can’t do it alone. [1]Charles Booker

Peter, I’m asking you to help send me to Washington -- here’s
why:

There’s so much room to do so much great work because we’ve been
struggling for a long time. Kentucky is one of the poorest states in the
country, and we can do much better.

I want to go to Washington to cast a vote to codify your right to privacy
and make your own decisions.

I want to go to Washington to cast a vote to take care of our teachers and
make sure they get the benefits they deserve.

I want to go to Washington to vote to take care of our Veterans, so they
aren’t left out on the streets or forced to suffer from devastating
illnesses and injuries.

I want to go to Washington to vote for affordable and sustainable housing,
better infrastructure, more money coming to Kentucky, better wages, clean
air, and clean water.

I want to go to Washington to cast a vote to protect democracy.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18827?t=1001&akid=2713%2E346206%2EqJG83G ]But I can’t do it without you. So please, pitch in $20 or more right

clean_body: | | Friend, I’m enthusiastically supporting Brenda Siegel to be our next Governor because she will fight for ALL Vermonters. I know from experience that she’ll put us first. I have been watching her do it for a long time. For years, she’s been advocating for the needs of Vermonters and helping move our state forward. She has been instrumental in crafting and passing important legislation to end homelessness, address the opioid crisis, and build an economy that works for all of us. Brenda needs our help getting over the top. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: Brenda would be an incredible leader for Vermont. Professional and life experience has left Brenda with a steadfast ability to work collaboratively with people of differing beliefs. This type of collaboration is what it takes to get the work done in state government. She’s the right leader for these times. I’m looking forward to working as U.S. Representative alongside Brenda as Governor to address the issues that matter most to you, the people of Vermont. That is why I am excited to vote for Brenda on November 8th and am doing all I can to help her and all of us win. This election is vitally important for our state. Business as usual just isn’t working. No statesman has better diagnosed the threat of modern technology; no statesman has spoken more effectively in opposition to socialism; and, no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny. We have had zero security at our southern border, and we watched millions of illegal immigrants pour into our country unabated. We have had zero economic or financial security, as rampant spending in Washington gave us the highest inflation we've seen in decades. We have had zero energy security, as Democrats have declared an all out assault on our oil and gas industry. We have had zero security in our communities as rising crime is making people too afraid to leave their homes. And we have had zero international security as Joe Biden's feckless leadership has emboldened our enemies.
No wonder Americans don't feel secure. That's why we need to do everything in our power to make sure Republicans take back the House, take back the Senate, and win elections up and down the ballot next Tuesday. If you talk to a voter who might be on the fence about voting for Republicans, tell them that Republicans are simply for security:

* We are for security at our southern border.
* We are for economic security, both as a country and for individual families.
* We are for energy security and your ability to have affordable and predictable prices at the pump and on your electricity bills.
* We are for security in our communities and ensuring violent criminals aren't running loose on our streets.
* And we are for securing the principles of our Founding and securing your fundamental rights guaranteed under our Constitution.

If we secure the majority next Tuesday and secure victories up and down the ballot, we will start to secure this country in all aspects. But we need to run through the tape. We can't afford to have ANYONE, including you, sitting on the sidelines.

We have exactly 5 days until Election Day, and Cheri Beasley needs you to contribute $5 to help us flip North Carolina.
#

We have exactly 5 days until Election Day, and Cheri Beasley needs you to contribute $5 to help us flip North Carolina.
Here are 5 reasons why we need your support today:
1. Two new polls in the past week have shown this race exactly tied. North Carolina is going to come down to a very small number of votes.

2. Outside Republican groups are spending over $64 million to defeat us. No Senate race in the entire country is facing as big of a spending gap as we are in North Carolina.

3. Our opponent Ted Budd was Donald Trump's first nonincumbent Senate endorsement this cycle — not long after Budd tried to overturn the 2020 election. He’s waffled on whether he’ll accept the results in our race, and he could easily try again in 2024 if we don’t defeat him.

4. If we elect Cheri, she will expand the majority and cast the decisive vote to protect abortion rights, raise wages and lower costs, and more!

5. Small-dollar donations are the number one source of support. So your $5 will make a big impact for our final GOTV efforts. We need to organize and turn out as many voters as possible from the Appalachian Mountains to the Outer Banks!

These are five important reasons to chip in $5. The decision is yours, but we have to ask:
[**Will you please make a $5 donation to flip North Carolina’s U.S. Senate seat and expand our majority? Whether we expand the Senate majority will come down to our statistically tied race, so every donation matters.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-nov22.g3HOlK&refcode=em221103-2-MA&t=1&akid=2213%2E357359%2EpKs-Xw)

Derek, did you see this note from John?
Time is running out to enter to win the chance to join John backstage at his rally in Philadelphia this coming Saturday, November 5. **We’re picking a winner TOMORROW!**

Add a donation of any amount to this email BEFORE MIDNIGHT to be automatically entered to win a chance to take a photo + rally with John in Philly!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-contest-20221105?refcode=em20221103-8033&refcode2=8033_434096_b-FIYK&akid=8033%2E434096%2Eb-FIYK)**

❤️ John

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Friend, I know you hear from me a lot, so this’ll be my last time reaching out to you today.
I just wanted to stress the absolute importance of my team’s 24-hour Rapid Response deadline, _which ends at midnight tonight._ **_[Before I continue, do you mind chipping in whatever you can before the deadline? Thanks so much.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53984460/377093022/-306078149?amount=25&refcode=20221103_f_8&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0Mjc4ZGIwZi1jNzViLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Dsn41ELiNU-aDApHYISqLZxgnS7uHYLgEQcqA-6Y4sE=)_**
With his support plummeting (a new poll showed me leading him 53% to 47%), Gov. Ron DeSantis has started jet-setting across the country, courting far-right, billionaire donors and begging them for money.
It’s working, too. They’re eagerly opening up their wallets for him, hoping he’ll win re-election so he can immediately pivot to running for president on their preferred policy platforms.
Here’s what I have to say to that: **Not on my watch.**
**Florida isn’t a stepping stone for Ron DeSantis’s political ambitions.** It’s a great state (the greatest state in America, in my opinion) full of wonderful, hard-working people who deserve better than a governor who cares more about his next campaign than their next paycheck.

Friends –
I've spent more than four decades making films that tell America’s stories, and examining the crises – internal and external – that we have faced as a nation, including threats to our democracy.
From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the First and Second World Wars to the COVID-19 pandemic, these crises have challenged us to live up to the essential promise of our nation, preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant, the democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
That’s why I’m reaching out. With a 50-50 split in the Senate, the fate of our Democratic majority—and our very democracy—hinges on what happens in New Hampshire.
Maggie Hassan is a vital voice in the Senate, and we cannot afford to lose her tireless work on behalf of Granite Staters—and in fact _all_ Americans. body:
| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7220bf1f08d64a70a74b017310644e2d&_e=YXAJTwbgdC73EUfkyY8zmNZ-CJ7U0_3g1IHwhELTcwNIvSAO1MPkj46Y-B487JTICTF9m61ZTo0VT_YmFufb9-pC0ntss4mejvaF6qbNBmDsUkqZXJc57Un1Vh272zm_EdqXTUhHAX93JSzeOdzDA23R8SCuoQtqUssXPD9Tjl4vhZMQ5Rc9T3sR6_i4vngSuP3T2P2jXeKBMrnyG4uPGc3B0asHeChm9TLdIqeGpRichgEzXyUSyGhwbwagTZHjfqgXjqiIWPsejPkbF3ESSB2K1nokyDCLvYtqnhg0ddJBzgBrzYiJct5FHr7pXgeH0mLOXRx2FDNABbGch3TtIZRzqQcq0bzdDf6yv8tACM8jDJBPPiXsGowYU8Rl2400d2uC6JcpuCm0Nb_pPRus_rF7A0kXUdzv1UoQVQXpWG0IK8UIB_DQDA2lrkpN8rJA "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7220bf1f08d64a70a74b017310644e2d&_e=YXAJTwbgdC73EUfkyY8zmNZ-CJ7U0_3g1IHwhELTcwNIvSAO1MPkj46Y-B487JTICTF9m61ZTo0VT_YmFufb9-pC0ntss4mejvaF6qbNBmDsUkqZXJc57Un1Vh272zm_EdqXTUhHAX93JSzeOdzDA23R8SCuoQtqUssXPD9Tjl4vhZMQ5Rc9T3sR6_i4vngSuP3T2P2jXeKBMrnyG4uPGc3B0asHeChm9TLdIqeGpRichgEzXyUSyGhwbwagTZHjfqgXjqiIWPsejPkbF3ESSB2K1nokyDCLvYtqnhg0ddIzz_hKaAUadqr02QdnEGrqUSjv08zL_-pUIfC-eZJvxBPW5btPf_fyvDDlBFKv5WNGHMU1gTeHd0lesb0FmKNd8q-xWnVVXnyGGM3GUAV2_cIqlFCWsFbJujx-JdfVLeOOTNuDLj9vIj1f9XqfNq_5 "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7220bf1f08d64a70a74b017310644e2d&_e=YXAJTwbgdC73EUfkyY8zmNZ-CJ7U0_3g1IHwhELTcwNIvSAO1MPkj46Y-B487JTICTF9m61ZTo0VT_YmFufb9-pC0ntss4mejvaF6qbNBmDsUkqZXJc57Un1Vh272zm_EdqXTUhHAX93JSzeOdzDA23R8SCuoQtqUssXPD9Tjl4vhZMQ5Rc9T3sR6_i4vngSuP3T2P2jXeKBMrnyG4uPGc3B0asHeChm9TLdIqeGpRichgEzXyUSyGhwbwagTZHjfqgXjqiIWPsejPkbF3ESSB2K1nokyDCLvYtqnhg0ddJSC7O0YXRp-0m-ItICmtq4IMfdgYGejVZdo7nuPTXhUiURYHqpbs-jTI7Fi6FvHo4V86blB2JRicIzFfQAxCoLRF8SDSGrKDbgmY5YjqVrZPsTOKXlo0YRxlraPd33uLJrCjHkIbTvsqXdP3LJMwPt "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---

_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7220bf1f08d64a70a74b017310644e2d&_e=YXAJTwbgdC73EUfkyY8zmNZ-CJ7U0_3g1IHwhELTcwNIvSAO1MPkj46Y-B487JTICTF9m61ZTo0VT_YmFufb9-pC0ntss4mejvaF6qbNBmDsUkqZXJc57Un1Vh272zm_EdqXTUhHAX93JSzeOdzDA23R8SCuoQtqUssXPD9Tjl4vhZMQ5Rc9T3sR6_i4vngSuP3T2P2jXeKBMrnyG4uPGc3B0asHeChm9TLdIqeGpRichgEzXyUSyGhwbwagTZHjfqgXjqiIWPsejPkbF3ESSB2K1nokyDCLvYtqnhg0ddKhx-3ABYU2Wfo47m-79bpejSq9N8WH10zSStdVSg8ANgzdnsDTMyvvLl9KtCWlf-m5U5N0StpcJfQFsUOGULBoyBfDAry9-k3v67QqzwKpeBgtVYtKN4cayNbHAAvrnHd2gDVHV1otcVYOymgjl4uC "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---

---

body:

| [This is the final weekend before Election Day:
TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT TO GET OUT THE VOTE >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)
This is it, Peter. This is the last chance to pitch in to get-out-the-vote (GOTV) efforts and have your contribution make an impact before Election Day. A group of donors is triple matching every contribution for this final push.

Critical Senate races in Arizona, Georgia, Pennsylvania, Nevada, and Wisconsin are all polling within the margin of error.

_Each_ of these races has a climate champion -- like Raphael Warnock and John Fetterman -- up against a MAGA extremist -- like Herschel Walker and Mehmet Oz. **_Each_ of these races could hinge on whether or not environmental voters turn out.**

**Every. Single. Vote. Counts.**

We're running digital ads and knocking on voters' doors every day leading up to Tuesday. We're educating voters about the climate champions running for office who will promote clean energy, protect public lands, and fight back against Big Oil. This is our last chance to reach voters in swing states all over the country.

**This is your final opportunity to make sure that we reach and turn out every last climate voter.** In this crucial final weekend before November 8, the only way we'll make that happen is with your support.

Help us get out the vote on Election Day. [Chip in right now: as little as $5 means we'll be able to reach every voter. Our climate and democracy can't afford to lose in 2022.](https://links.messages.lcv.)

If _everyone_ reading this email gave today, we'd blow through our GOTV fundraising goal. Could you take a moment to donate below?

| | **
** **FOR IMMEDIATE REVIEW: TRIPLE MATCH STATUS**

**NAME:** Peter Willis
**SUPPORTER EMAIL:** dpwillis67@gmail.com
**GOAL:** $40,000
**PROGRESS:** _**Not on track.**_

**YOUR DONOR STATUS:** [STILL PENDING -- DONATE $5 TODAY >>](https://links.messages.lcv.) |
---|---|---

**These last few days are critical.** Connecting with voters is how we will get climate champions elected in the House, Senate, and in races up and down the ballot. It's how we will secure a just and sustainable clean energy future, not a world of continued pollution and climate devastation backed by Big Oil.

We have the momentum to meet our goal of knocking on nearly two million doors in vital swing states and districts, and your support can ensure that we make it over the finish line.

[Chip in today to help elect environmental champions and keep climate and election deniers out of Congress. There's still time for the environmental movement to make a difference on Election Day. Even $5 goes 3X as far to help us win on Tuesday >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)

**Every vote matters, Peter.** Thank you for being a part of building a better future.

Onward,

Pete Maysmith

The American Dream for our children is on the line, and that’s something I take to heart.

_**[I’m ready to win big on November 8, but I need to know I can count on you in the final days.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ab9b49c31fb042aabe5815ee30351549&_e=VVcpQjMkJDpbfP2gnILwmAROXvBCJxmiCPXkXNezaR6OzJnIQoR1-JlKFgDCd_k20dvm5In102pkk_DpIUpmb7-vro5ZngU9kRrVPdXTRJ-7KKgGji-VNjPcilfOrJGcurTjMvlm6IDfLcDqniJvjgF1m7ctoPploAhD7bzCrt4nfdF05Q1D08cqq7TRqPxE0utdBvljpLTCARMlpW42cPbstYCQ8q-1TJ9F-6h8Mx8o3rUnRYJiZhNXVIjc1cVMQHMlY5Ftb_OTq8L2L3FGB35J235iroe-QNa0RrXjAQIUyOxTW_x7yiQrXo1CgTheAYeTy1r22kyJ2VtGVfZbuJ0hGRbdWpscP_tt1eZBd8OMufEOVrppgyNOxMC4T8jZ9MiIV42bNPF7p_HueQutArbLwPYfCrBDTPO9tM31sWUze5bylgkWcqcUtlTIDb6m "I’m ready to win big on November 8, but I need to know I can count on you in the final days.")**_

Tiffany Smiley

body:

---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I decided to run for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a168a4af0dcc463aad5ed79c8fe02edc&_e=MpaiN25euC1dTl2WVywUqjpa2EyPW-NyrlGQ9zgqxbQ3k3ClOoLT37K49DRWcYwRZvVRhBkStHglmQO1VMYPPq48CBHnmE1VAjhfMl2SsSCdG6-cz684-HsOpzY_zgtnQuq1MgfneiCJUw_ZKK6rn-Xc9ZYPTJzNIuYSMb1digBPrxFWsVsnvh6_yJ_YAQWbh8mujTJ8PvCsdnOz5lGZ9I_rXWU98LD1-xp3U9Z5VnM6URmY65GxEkjCKUEGtfSHQPUB7PDOf6bL_ZtiLFWbqh3aLsokdqhCciKH0kiL5IyF7nIwIgj4C28jbPjhtMIOHsfePBR7cr5RipER9TLpVun2K1nMqgQ-2GJn0aBPAJL_6F913uz4QzNBkg5eZxmAMmmSPam1WW8j8hNzSnWJDuSJpuHiy2e39D4OD2_rTblCAILxRoyvX-aK8vv0KmmU "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a168a4af0dcc463aad5ed79c8fe02edc&_e=MpaiN25euC1dTl2WVywUqjpa2EyPW-NyrlGQ9zgqxbQ3k3ClOoLT37K49DRWcYwRZvVRhBkStHglmQO1VMYPPq48CBHnmE1VAjhfMl2SsSCdG6-cz684-HsOpzY_zgtnQuq1MgfneiCJUw_ZKK6rn-Xc9ZYPTJzNIuYSMb1digBPrxFWsVsnvh6_yJ_YAQWbh8mujTJ8PvCsdnOz5lGZ9I_rXWU98LD1-xp3U9Z5VnM6URmY65GxEkjCKUEGtfSHQPUB7PDOf6bL_ZtiLFWbqh3aLsokdqhCciKH0kiL5IxvKSl8831H6g945lLZKPiUbjxOfBfsopKthTMpAtbDVqesDKtUXqC7B0Mt6WGWG8bydT76i3lp7ap1isIcMxPWnIvdK_tkIm19vboQbnhJfEFtMVAp3p06p337Ilbc44SKBrO8eVfOybQeTfbaVFHW "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a168a4af0dcc463aad5ed79c8fe02edc&_e=MpaiN25euC1dTl2WVywUqjpa2EyPW-NyrlGQ9zgqxbQ3k3ClOoLT37K49DRWcYwRZvVRhBkStHglmQO1VMYPPq48CBHnmE1VAjhfMl2SsSCdG6-cz684-HsOpzY_zgtnQuq1MgfneiCJUw_ZKK6rn-Xc9ZYPTJzNIuYSMb1digBPrxFWsVsnvh6_yJ_YAQWbh8mujTJ8PvCsdnOz5lGZ9I_rXWU98LD1-xp3U9Z5VnM6URmY65GxEkjCKUEGtfSHQPUB7PDOf6bL_ZtiLFWbqh3aLsokdqhCciKH0kiL5Ix0zW63-tAxxAsVmrYy5Sub-iwXF8D4azgOILFRUwBH2aq5QMlyrRCuA84p08PBS90I-ZyHdADwMJNMU92zzDywkwqmq3S_NZT6cPG_tmnApinEwMTg5iZMp4ZLXdP4hx83TRoj_L5V6ktWdKVr7GRr "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a168a4af0dcc463aad5ed79c8fe02edc&_e=MpaiN25euC1dTl2WVywUqjpa2EyPW-NyrlGQ9zgqxbQ3k3ClOoLT37K49DRWcYwRZvVRhBkStHglmQO1VMYPPq48CBHnmE1VAjhfMl2SsSCdG6-cz684-HsOpzY_zgtnQuq1MgfneiCJUw_ZKK6rn-Xc9ZYPTJzNIuYSMb1digBPrxFWsVsnvh6_yJ_YAQWbh8mujTJ8PvCsdnOz5lGZ9I_rXWU98LD1-xp3U9Z5VnM6URmY65GxEkjCKUEGtfSHQPUB7PDOf6bL_ZtiLFWbqh3aLsokdqhCciKH0kiL5IxBneYs1scdN86TgERJia_a7VUle-3xIyIdjoU7LaNy0nqEd1FZtrCE2VvMwgQrMpd-8GtQVb7tET7e89-2S4YhdZTZfqHgCLLmHs3fuosH2CkXkhIeLlSegcOMydmmaN8-QuoH5NWAOHo87vNDUh6r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a168a4af0dcc463aad5ed79c8fe02edc&_e=MpaiN25euC1dTl2WVywUqjpa2EyPW-NyrlGQ9zgqxbQ3k3ClOoLT37K49DRWcYwRZvVRhBkStHglmQO1VMYPPq48CBHnmE1VAjhfMl2SsSCdG6-cz684-HsOpzY_zgtnQuq1MgfneiCJUw_ZKK6rn-Xc9ZYPTJzNIuYSMb1digBPrxFWsVsnvh6_yJ_YAQWbh8mujTJ8PvCsdnOz5lGZ9I_rXWU98LD1-xp3U9Z5VnM6URmY65GxEkjCKUEGtfSHQPUB7PDOf6bL_ZtiLFWbqh3aLsokdqhCciKH0kiL5IyKofzwJPJfTJzwMvnBRh3yh1gp6ZvY8fhjhSFeL3p5lncErcrRewq36dHymWNc10z6tvvxQhaMFz7XP7PiMufqpAseM6uX8MXduNHheYYGWAZpI2ib-Rc9OzvR_9ehPWaXxp78x20HwnkxCVO2EiLC "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a168a4af0dcc463aad5ed79c8fe02edc&_e=MpaiN25euC1dTl2WVywUqjpa2EyPW-NyrlGQ9zgqxbQ3k3ClOoLT37K49DRWcYwRZvVRhBkStHglmQO1VMYPPq48CBHnmE1VAjhfMl2SsSCdG6-cz684-HsOpzY_zgtnQuq1MgfneiCJUw_ZKK6rn-Xc9ZYPTJzNIuYSMb1digBPrxFWsVsnvh6_yJ_YAQWbh8mujTJ8PvCsdnOz5lGZ9I_rXWU98LD1-xp3U9Z5VnM6URmY65GxEkjCKUEGtfSHQPUB7PDOf6bL_ZtiLFWbqh3aLsokdqhCciKH0kiL5IwLQ5WvsnhY6CjtMj5_iHkB4p64BajekxP0nKC3zjVajXUW2NGZpeO1EUyFjLdSwL74irsx36U5nt0smLj0w3fFXNUuV0cXj5vV0Flz9MkY65OL41w3rrCDO-wxb_IUOe5BPqn9gTggzetxzGr0ChjT "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a168a4af0dcc463aad5ed79c8fe02edc&_e=MpaiN25euC1dTl2WVywUqjpa2EyPW-NyrlGQ9zgqxbQ3k3ClOoLT37K49DRWcYwRZvVRhBkStHglmQO1VMYPPq48CBHnmE1VAjhfMl2SsSCdG6-cz684-HsOpzY_zgtnQuq1MgfneiCJUw_ZKK6rn-Xc9ZYPTJzNIuYSMb1digBPrxFWsVsnvh6_yJ_YAQWbh8mujTJ8PvCsdnOz5lGZ9I_rXWU98LD1-xp3U9Z5VnM6URmY65GxEkjCKUEGtfSHQPUB7PDOf6bL_ZtiLFWbqh3aLsokdqhCciKH0kiL5Iw6sVgVZkjx95E_koR7yTYYhbq1pqYxOxHN7oXqY-z643z0gXF3be6kOzNa4yYXdoyeu1yPYVs55UKi1Ux7b-G8Ss6OcgoAdXRCHNBh4fPUee9GHVJznfpryLENQZ4lGt20YX9RUOJBnQYmrCYsjV4Q "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a168a4af0dcc463aad5ed79c8fe02edc&_e=MpaiN25euC1dTl2WVywUqjpa2EyPW-NyrlGQ9zgqxbQ3k3ClOoLT37K49DRWcYwRZvVRhBkStHglmQO1VMYPPq48CBHnmE1VAjhfMl2SsSCdG6-cz684-HsOpzY_zgtnQuq1MgfneiCJUw_ZKK6rn-Xc9ZYPTJzNIuYSMb1digBPrxFWsVsnvh6_yJ_YAQWbh8mujTJ8PvCsdnOz5lGZ9I_rXWU98LD1-xp3U9Z5VnM6URmY65GxEkjCKUEGtfSHQPUB7PDOf6bL_ZtiLFWbqh3aLsokdqhCciKH0kiL5IyHxHUnvNp_a2O7ym4dUj11j3E_7RpQ5v2VleKP_Fvoph9K5IIFzqyg6PbB34PoDo61r552Ey3KxPTCtatG4OshRp7-3iaK6pPmnqtxzr_gbY7DzTkEX7TkmLSnuToaAHdp1uMJLWeEpcRFtPpOEzqq "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family has decided to take on a new challenge. I made the choice to run for U.S. Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a168a4af0dcc463aad5ed79c8fe02edc&_e=MpaiN25euC1dTl2WVywUqjpa2EyPW-NyrlGQ9zgqxbQ3k3ClOoLT37K49DRWcYwRZvVRhBkStHglmQO1VMYPPq48CBHnmE1VAjhfMl2SsSCdG6-cz684-HsOpzY_zgtnQuq1MgfneiCJUw_ZKK6rn-Xc9ZYPTJzNIuYSMb1digBPrxFWsVsnvh6_yJ_YAQWbh8mujTJ8PvCsdnOz5lGZ9I_rXWU98LD1-xp3U9Z5VnM6URmY65GxEkjCKUEGtfSHQPUB7PDOf6bL_ZtiLFWbqh3aLsokdqhCciKH0kiL5Iy1g9VnqYUZuxh8e5qfVsIL7pG1vbi4gmBJ_X5zte-ngxkBMcr9rCDH_TeOiLBmEV3L2mOZjfEgN-r3Y-Wqn_rrbRLkul7h6VXmsNgqP43pNkw7zyn7C1g7FPbHD7hPTxGIVEEAx__fvyK3NzaP1xou "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a168a4af0dcc463aad5ed79c8fe02edc&_e=MpaiN25euC1dTl2WVywUqjpa2EyPW-NyrlGQ9zgqxbQ3k3ClOoLT37K49DRWcYwRZvVRhBkStHglmQO1VMYPPq48CBHnmE1VAjhfMl2SsSCdG6-cz684-HsOpzY_zgtnQuq1MgfneiCJUw_ZKK6rn-Xc9ZYPTJzNIuYSMb1digBPrxFWsVsnvh6_yJ_YAQWbh8mujTJ8PvCsdnOz5lGZ9I_rXWU98LD1-xp3U9Z5VnM6URmY65GxEkjCKUEGtfSHQPUB7PDOf6bL_ZtiLFWbqh3aLsokdqhCciKH0kiL5Iye8oRbs0_T-CofGqSkozB1kFYgeQ1hM0Kb-Y8TU9eqtz96eWYyRMNUNg5wAqflwyxcBJuYjsoW0mU_nIdwlxg4YTbx0-XFP6OKzMCJtEhVi6-tKj72Kt3Q1IwlgoR8wbCN4y2c7drq2Aadj4PuwJvO "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

Team —

[**With only five days to go, I am counting on your support more than ever before to keep our people-powered campaign from being drowned out by Caruso's spending and make sure more Angelenos learn about our plans for LA. We've been preparing for this final week _for months._ Our volunteers are hard at work knocking on doors across the city and calling voters so they know what's at stake.

The latest poll shows I'm neck-and-neck with Caruso. The outcome of this race could come down to just a handful of votes.

clean_body: I can’t overstate how important this upcoming election is. Friends, I’ve served my country in the Navy, at NASA, and now in the Senate. No matter where I’ve been or what I was doing, I’ve always used science, data, and facts to make tough decisions. And right now, the facts tell me that we’re in trouble. National Republicans are attacking the right to abortion, denying the devastating impact climate change is having on our planet, and spreading misinformation about the integrity of our elections nationwide. But I refuse to let them win. I didn’t spend more than 54 days in space observing the damage climate change is wreaking on our planet just for far-right extremists to deny the truth and refuse to take action. I think our leaders should follow the facts, listen to the science, and act decisively — = I didn’t serve 25 years in the Navy just for Republicans to threaten our country from within by sowing doubt and misinformation about the integrity of our elections. And if I can get 1500 supporters to step up and chip in $25 each from this email, we'll be in good shape.**](https://he35og.fd52.fdske.com/ec/gAAAAABjZB4EMYufQkblbovoGvzIoAMuYhqEcPcDvxbF6jewYDEh8ueoFzSobH6Og3TlAOJxbECORK99icRZAfpWO08TPrWEBKeUDKObjwSRtYsNLWOGgur_ww8gF-6RO-jWh0VK8Q9pgEym2eqoncISiyGpKF8NLm1tTJdBN01HGXRsCZKatrP71etzI5bcfN6exW1NWSfwq3BYuGnuOsR-ucyj6AQhMTEhgcFCJ2jZyrrn8a-BbW0Q8V6xMZCwI91Mh-f29BlB4i2DVeyXxaAkalUyg-cglPd2LY-6410CIjASBQrhnUFa8MTgVJ1thG8kwT-AyJfdQl39COjuhMmN7rxni8c1u5ksRRsMQXObdZxqMQZIoPJSTVhoVneCt3EtvdxninZ6r0t_Zn83pWv6VMieVENKF1nowV4NtNxChmra7RIAhZA=) Will you help us out today by stepping up and being one of the 1500 supporters we need? I'll level with you: things aren't looking good. We're hitting a serious lull in our fundraising at the worst time imaginable. So I'm hoping that a few folks just like you can chip in $20 each and help us get back on track. body:
Could you take just a moment to read this message? It is important.
| | |
---
Hi Peter,

It's Trudy again. With the election just 5 days away, I know you've gotten a lot of emails from my team and me. But please, could you take just a moment to read this one? It is important.
You see, it wasn't an easy choice for me, deciding to run for Senate. **During this season of my life, I thought I would be spending time with my loving husband and our family, giving back to my community through volunteer work, and spending time with my kids and eight beautiful grandchildren.** Running for office was never what I had planned.
**But Peter, our country is headed in the wrong direction.** Division and extremism are pulling us apart at the seams. And while it's tempting to tune all of that out, I know that this work demands all of us. You see, the things happening in Washington will affect every state, every community, and every family.
**I knew that I had to do _something._**
So just as I stepped up to serve my state as a children's advocate, my community as a nurse, and my family as a widowed mom, I stepped up again.
And let me tell you, Peter, this campaign has been an unbelievably rewarding and inspiring experience. **I've met countless voters and had the unique privilege of listening to their stories, their ideas, and their hopes for the future.**
We've built an incredible grassroots team of people all across Missouri who are fired up and ready for the change we know is possible.**I know that this team has what it takes to win, but now, with the election just days away, we need to prove it to the talking heads, the naysayers, and our opponents.**
**There's so much on the line here.[So please, can I count on your $5 grassroots donation before my 11:59 p.m. deadline tonight? # **Focus On The Issues - Deliver With Results**
[](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=ed4a9c5571&e=659fba240e) We are **5 days away from Election Day** and I continue to meet all voters in every corner of Arizona's 6th congressional district.

Our district __expects__ their representative to be present, engaged and not shy away from any community or topic.

**I've shown up to all rooms, reached out to the Hispanic community in Spanish, and talked about every issue. Every issue matters and impacts us all. **_I am reaching out to the Hispanic community with the same message: a message of opportunity. _

With high grocery prices, an immigration crisis, and rising crime, we need an independent voice representing our district and delivering results. Not a rubber stamp for the reckless policies coming out of DC.

As we enter these final days, I have two asks:

1\. Cast your vote for JUAN CISCOMANI! _If you still have your ballot, turn it in at a county polling location near you. If you are voting on Election Day, make a plan for Tuesday, November 8th to cast your vote._

My priority will always be our district. It's where I grew up, where I live now, and where Laura and I are raising our kids.

State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

I'm here to tell you our plan of action and if you can chip in as much as you can to help us get more Democrats out to vote, I'll leave a link [**here.**](https://act.myngp.com/el/mA-jalS63vuM5nzUf5L7R5qGnlFFKfkb1XeTuTgOdk0=/vLY-dpbW_qryWuGPyMc0nqpo_tWVCsBCCUaR9ZnIK0s=?refcode=E19269-20221103-PlanOfAction-SL-CampaignNews-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=25) It will genuinely make the difference between us winning and losing. Every vote is going to matter in this toss-up seat. **So here is how we 're going to turn things around:** _First,_ we have until tomorrow to launch our final round of TV investments and we're going up with one more ad reminding voters what's at stake in this race. _Second,_ we're mobilizing an unprecedented effort to get young people and Latino voters to return their ballots - two key constituencies that will decide the outcome of this campaign. _Finally,_ our team is recruiting hundreds of volunteers to knock doors and get people to the polls on Election Day. The only way we're going to increase Democratic turnout is by actually engaging with voters and reminding them to return their ballots for Josh. Here’s what he said: I’ll be blunt with you: Doug Mastriano truly thinks he’s going to win this election. He’s telling his supporters that “this is a 2-point race” and that he has a massive plan to “take back Pennsylvania.” Mastriano’s campaign manager said just this week that he’s in “a dead heat” and that “Doug has ALL the momentum and Doug WILL win this race.” Despite his extremism and dangerous beliefs,he is growing a fervent base of support — we cannot dismiss him. I’m glad Josh Shapiro is running scared, Peter. Because this IS a 2-point race , we ARE growing a fervent base of support , and on November 8, we WILL take back Pennsylvania. Shapiro signs off with a desperate plea for money: “To help make that happen — and to shake Mastriano’s belief that he’ll win — we need to create an outpouring of support.” Peter, nothing will shake my belief that I’m going to win... but we sure as heck can make Josh Shapiro keep sweating with an “outpouring of support” of our very own. | | | | Thanks, Doug | | | | | | PAID FOR BY FRIENDS OF DOUG MASTRIANO PO Box 138, Fayetteville PA 17222

clean_body: Since taking office, we’ve fought to restore the soul of this nation, restore the middle class, and unite the country. | | Derek, I believe with every fiber of my being that there’s not a thing in the world America can’t do if we set our mind to it. Since taking office, we’ve fought to restore the soul of this nation, restore the middle class, and unite the country. We put hundreds of millions of shots in arms, passed one of the single largest investments in infrastructure in American history, and put the first African American woman, Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson, on the Supreme Court. Every bit of progress we’ve made has been possible because of folks on this grassroots team. But if MAGA Republicans win, women could lose the right to choose anywhere in America. The right to contraception and marriage equality -- the whole right to privacy -- could be at risk. We can’t let that happen. And I don’t believe we will. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

| | It has not been an easy year for my family to navigate everything thrown in our path, and even through the demanding schedule of the campaign, I could always call on my dad to help me navigate the highs and lows of life. He's still the same dad he always has been; there to provide advice, support, a listening ear, and the occasional medical and parental advice. Now, just days out from the election, I find myself excited and incredibly proud of what my father has been able to accomplish. Aside from a war chest and a huge political party apparatus, he has what should be deemed more important in the political sphere:
* He has thousands of people who met him at one or more of his events.
* He has thousands of emails he has responded to, providing his position on vital issues from people in the district.
* He has thousands of phone calls that he has made to people with questions, thoughts, wonderings, or ideas to share.
* He has stayed in countless hotels throughout the district and driven many miles, constantly texting the family when he arrives home late at night after campaign events.
* He has personally helped craft just about every part of the campaign.
* And, what he probably cares about the most, he has a proud family - proud of his conduct throughout the campaign. We love him for his passion and dedication.

I am excited to be back in my hometown of Marquette for election day. I will be there with my daughter, and we will be helping out with the campaign however we can in those final days. She's excited to support Grandpa Bob, and I am proud to be knocking on doors for my dad. He is the type of person I would want to represent my family and me, not because he is my dad, but because he has shown he knows what it means to be a leader. He is dedicated to service and true representation. Can we count on your support to carry us to the finish line? We need to continue our fundraising momentum to complete the final projects of the campaign. Thank you!
\- Peter Lorinser

| **RENO, NV –** Today, Republican U.S. Senate candidate Adam Laxalt’s campaign released the following statement after [a news report](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=519b70187c&e=018ab83301 "https://www.foxnews.com/politics/vulnerable-senate-dems-take-thousands-ccp-tied-huawei-lobbyist") revealed Senator Catherine Cortez Masto received a large donation from a Washington, D.C. lobbyist for Huawei, a Chinese telecommunications company labeled by the FCC as a national security threat for its ties to the Chinese Government. Huawei is currently under investigation by the U.S. Department of Justice and stands charged with serious crimes. **“Catherine Cortez Masto’s losing campaign is being bankrolled by a lobbyist currently working for a Chinese government-connected company,”** said Laxalt campaign communications director Courtney Holland. **“While she’s using this money to spread [false attacks](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=33dd761753&e=018ab83301 "https://twitter.com/MattWolking/status/1587846313152249856") about Adam Laxalt, Cortez Masto is cozying up to a lobbyist helping to undermine America’s national security. She should return this money immediately. Nevadans should vote for Laxalt to protect our democracy from Communist China and stop Cortez Masto’s corruption.”** Today, Cortez Masto’s campaign refused to comment when asked whether she will keep the money she received a few weeks ago from Huawei’s lobbyist. Last week, the DOJ announced charges against [Chinese spies](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=b10872fc92&e=018ab83301 "https://www.cnn.com/2022/10/24/politics/chinese-spies-huawei") who were trying to obstruct the investigation into Huawei. This is not the first time Cortez Masto has taken money connected to foreign governments. She previously [took money from Hunter Biden](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=5115db79c9&e=018ab83301 "https://youtu.be/wxSEIqifWYA") after he inked a deal with the Bank of China, joined the board of Ukrainian gas company Burisma, and received a large wire transfer from a Russian billionaire. Cortez Masto has [refused to say](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=e40a692e86&e=018ab83301 "https://twitter.com/TeamLaxalt/status/1579852107993075713") whether her husband worked for any of Hunter Biden’s foreign business connections. Cortez Masto previously [said](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=9b04e06e6b&e=018ab83301 "https://youtu.be/fgh0IJjO5FA"), “I am going to be there 100% for Joe Biden.”

name: Laurie Teper
subject: Important Updates!
body:
Hey Team!
We cannot thank you enough for all you have done thus far! You are an amazing group of dedicated volunteers and each one of you is appreciated more than you know! As a team, we are making an impact and starting to rattle the Democrat cages. I think they are realizing that Valerie Foushee is not a shoe-in!

I am resending the 25 minute training video that Courtney recorded for ALL volunteers working the polls. **We strongly encourage you to watch it if you have not seen it yet. She has guidelines she would like you to follow plus she addresses the top 3 questions volunteers have asked.**
<https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cGV7Ih_iegAaCoTYmKoXyrjyNFhJjjvU/view?ts=6346bd18>

Based on my experience since early voting began, most of the Democrat volunteers/poll workers have been very pleasant and friendly. However, there are a few that can spoil it for the rest of us. I had a situation this morning when I was talking to a voter and handing out Courtney's card, the Durham Democrat volunteer was talking over me and saying "She's a Republican". After a few times, (and she is pointing out Valerie on her sample ballot stating David Price is retiring and he endorses Valerie), I asked her to stop talking over me since I was talking. She did stop but when I was finished, she'd yell "She's a Republican". I told her I think the voter would see that she is a Republican when they see the ballot. She continued to say David Price endorses Valerie. I told her it is not true since I searched the internet and couldn't find anything of the sort. She eventually stopped saying that as well. So....if opposition poll workers are being disrespectful and/or consistently talking over you, politely ask them to stop and if it doesn't, please contact me or LaRayne immediately.

If someone continuously yells out "She's a Republican," you have full permission to say to the voter... "You know, I think she is insulting your intelligence that she doesn't think you can read the word Republican on the ballot! Courtney is a Republican, but she constantly goes against the grain of the establishment of the republican party, and she will certainly stir the pot of the bureaucracy of politicians on both sides of the aisle that are just up in Washington for power and money. She has been a nurse for 10 years, and she isn't a politician. I hope you will consider her."

We are still scheduling for Election Day, Tuesday, the 8th, so please respond to this email with your availability if you are not already scheduled. We would rather get these shifts committed so we are not scrambling around on Monday when we will all be needing a much needed rest!

Thank you again for all you have done and continue to do. Let's cross the finish line well!

Laurie - 847-212-5651
LaRayne - [612-240-8228](tel:+16122408228)

__Fighting for Truth, Justice and Unity Together!__
Laurie Teper
Volunteer Director
Courtney Geels for Congress NC04
Email: [volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com)
Cell: (847)212-5651
[courtneygeelsforcongress.com](http://courtneygeelsforcongress.com)

# A Republic If You Can Keep It
---
|
---
|
---
| "I wholeheartedly endorse the attached letter signed by distinguished Retired Generals and Admirals.
This letter perfectly encapsulates my concerns for America's future and the dangerous reality that the greatest threat we as Americans are facing today does not come from a foreign enemy, but from an enemy within. Political correctness has demeaned and silenced the masses, the continuous push to defund the police and open our borders has placed our children in extreme danger, and the treacherous push for Marxist and Socialist ideologies in our schools, politics and day to day lives has harmed us and will continue to harm us unless we do something to stop it.
Fortunately, on November 8th we have an opportunity to put a stop to this perilous erosion of all we hold dear. Vote for our Constitutional Republic this election season, all our futures depend on it. "

| |
---
| "A Republic If You Can Keep It"
# Open Letter from Retired Generals and Admirals
---
| | |
---|---
|
A May 2021, open letter signed by retired generals and admirals warned our Nation was in deep peril in a fight for our survival as a Constitutional Republic against Socialism/Marxism. Today, our nation is on the precipice of losing that fight for our cherished Liberty as enumerated in our Constitution, the document to which we swear our military Oaths.

If the expansion of Socialism/Marxism is not stopped, we will lose it to that deadly and suppressive ideology. Historically, socialism requires an authoritarian form of government like Marxism to impose it on free people. It cannot be done unless "we the people" sacrifice our Constitutional freedoms and become compliant to unconstitutional government mandates and intrusions into everyday lives. COVID was used as the tool to suppress our freedom and as justification for massive mail-in balloting resulting in reports of fraud. Reasonable voter verification is now opposed and called racist. Without fair and honest elections that accurately record the legal votes of citizens, we have lost our Republic to one party authoritarian rule.

Many ask, "How can this be?" The short answer is we've been too complacent, while over 60+ years the ideology of Marxism/Socialism with associated corruption has slowly infiltrated into our major institutions to wit: educational system, news & social media, political system, judicial system, entertainment industry, corporations, and now tragically our military.

We took an oath ".,.to support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies foreign and domestic..." Our greatest foreign threat is China, followed by Russia, Iran, N. Korea, and Islamic terrorism. We warned in Aug 2021, the debacle in Afghanistan where the Biden Administration politically surrendered to terrorists would embolden foreign threats. Putin's invasion of Ukraine and China's aggression toward Taiwan are tied to the Afghanistan surrender. Such foreign powers see weakness and no longer fear the consequences (deterrence factor) coming from the United States in response to their aggression.

The greatest threat to our survival is "domestic", not "foreign". Those who believe Socialism/Marxism is acceptable fail to look at history; that ideology leads to death and destruction. Considering just Stalin, Mao, and Pol Pot, estimates are they killed over 100 million people. America has fought Socialists/Marxists during the Cold War with the Soviets (1947-91); in the 1950s and 60s we fought communists in Korea and Vietnam. Over 95,000 brave Americans were killed in those wars by the same ideology that now controls our government in the Administration and Congress! Ponder that.

Political correctness has caused our military to lose focus on the reason it exists: to fight and win our Nation's wars. "Woke" social programs like CRT and Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) are divisive as they tear at the trust and confidence our warriors must have in each other. Foreign threats are encouraged by such self-inflicted weakening of our military as the corrosive mandatory "woke" training occurs in our Services. Public trust in the military has declined in recent years, and Army recruiting is the worst since 1973 causing very dangerous reductions in force size. The defense budget does not keep up with 40 year high inflation while the IRS hires 87,000 new agents.

The tenets of divisive programs like CRT and DEI, are being taught throughout our education system, corporate America, and the federal government including our military. These are Marxist techniques casting us
into opposing groups based on the oppressed vs the oppressors, mostly along racial lines. The purpose is to sow seeds of distrust which often leads to civil unrest and increasing violence as seen in many large cities.

The "rule of law" is lost when a double standard exists, laws are selectively enforced, mayors and DAs decide when to prosecute based on politics, preference goes to criminals over victims, the DOJ/FBI is weaponized against parents speaking at school board meetings, and now blatantly against political opponents. De-fund the police movements endanger all Americans, especially in large cities where minorities often suffer the most. Without the "rule of law" and accountability, we have lost our Republic.

Other destructive actions taken by the Administration and Congress which cripple our Country include:

* Open borders allowing 2+ million illegals, with unknown numbers of criminals, cartel members, terrorists, drug and sex traffickers, illegal drugs, entering our Country; widely dispersed into various states; paid for at great taxpayer expense. Without Title 42, estimates are 18,000 illegals will cross our border daily totaling ~6 million more during the Biden Administration.
* Uncontrolled spending causing the highest inflation in 40 years. COVID lockdowns upset our work ethic by keeping people at home and giving some more money to not work than work, driving thousands of small businesses into bankruptcy making more people dependent on the government--socialism happening.
* War on fossil fuels--going from energy independence to energy dependence and reaching the highest gas prices on record; asking our adversaries to bail us out and depleting our strategic petroleum reserves instead of unshackling our own massive domestic production capability.

The assault on free speech and censorship coming from governmental agencies, the media, tech giants, the educational system, etc., is tyrannical. When people are afraid to say in public what they say in private, then freedom of speech is lost to cancel culture, censorship and intimidation.

American citizens must stand up now for our Constitution and Rights through peaceful resistance to the Socialist/Marxist movement. A "Citizen's Action Plan for America" offers ideas for grassroots action, found at [flagofficers4america.com](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001KtQ3GSR7Ud_zDvLVZcfnTlgGgSxTs-qJHX6LoQrSbZvAKoaIbZkK2OOEu04Q-thI7sV6Yzp1IqPW4FpvB0BiqpaEXDqcOxApAcGJ8mCIblvRLlAzYXZj7dLn44hbQlmhIFCSZVAK1zOFzyRjKYsFv77nKvP4ABFj&c=0YxN-6S4Bto33b7PIFQZVTuGSoa6hZ34NOvNrYXg6KfCxAxIvIJjNA==&ch=xodWuPARFi5K-IqVxRSib1V5x_XfUyVBskEJTHFZwcysUQkmvwPNqA==). Citizens must contact political representatives at the local, state, and national levels to voice support for a strong mission focused military, secure borders, election integrity, the rule of law, and against censorship and government overreach. Citizens must vote in the 2022 election for candidates who support traditional values in order to constitutionally take back control of our government.

We are at a historic crossroads equal in importance to 1776. Do we hold true to our Constitutional Republic or succumb to the failed and deadly Socialist/Marxist ideology? The answer depends on citizens getting involved and acting to protect their Constitutional Rights and Liberty. National Security issues can be solved with changes to existing political policies, but that requires replacing politicians holding Socialist/Marxist ideologies with those who have the courage to defend our Constitution. Elections have huge consequences.

This letter perfectly encapsulates my concerns for America's future and the dangerous reality that the greatest threat we as Americans are facing today does not come from a foreign enemy, but from an enemy within. Political correctness has demeaned and silenced the masses, the continuous push to defund the police and open our borders has placed our children in extreme danger, and the treacherous push for Marxist and Socialist ideologies in our schools, politics and day to day lives has harmed us and will continue to harm us unless we do something to stop it. " | | | "A Republic If You Can Keep It" Open Letter from Retired Generals and Admirals | | | ---|--- | A May 2021, open letter signed by retired generals and admirals warned our Nation was in deep peril in a fight for our survival as a Constitutional Republic against Socialism/Marxism. Today, our nation is on the precipice of losing that fight for our cherished Liberty as enumerated in our Constitution, the document to which we swear our military Oaths. If the expansion of Socialism/Marxism is not stopped, we will lose it to that deadly and suppressive ideology. Historically, socialism requires an authoritarian form of government like Marxism to impose it on free people. It cannot be done unless "we the people" sacrifice our Constitutional freedoms and become compliant to unconstitutional government mandates and intrusions into everyday lives. COVID was used as the tool to suppress our freedom and as justification for massive mail-in balloting resulting in reports of fraud. Reasonable voter verification is now opposed and called racist. Without fair and honest elections that accurately record the legal votes of citizens, we have lost our Republic to one party authoritarian rule. Many ask, "How can this be?" The short answer is we've been too complacent, while over 60+ years the ideology of Marxism/Socialism with associated corruption has slowly infiltrated into our major institutions to wit: educational system, news & social media, political system, judicial system, entertainment industry, corporations, and now tragically our military. We took an oath ".,.to support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies foreign and domestic..." Our greatest foreign threat is China, followed by Russia, Iran, N. Korea, and Islamic terrorism. We warned in Aug 2021, the debacle in Afghanistan where the Biden Administration politically surrendered to terrorists would embolden foreign threats. Putin's invasion of Ukraine and China's aggression toward Taiwan are tied to the Afghanistan surrender. Such foreign powers see weakness and no longer fear the consequences (deterrence factor) coming from the United States in response to their aggression. The greatest threat to our survival is "domestic", not "foreign". Those who believe Socialism/Marxism is acceptable fail to look at history; that ideology leads to death and destruction. Considering just Stalin, Mao, and Pol Pot, estimates are they killed over 100 million people. America has fought Socialists/Marxists during the Cold War with the Soviets (1947-91); in the 1950s and 60s we fought communists in Korea and Vietnam. Over 95,000 brave Americans were killed in those wars by the same ideology that now controls our government in the Administration and Congress! Ponder that. Political correctness has caused our military to lose focus on the reason it exists: to fight and win our Nation's wars. "Woke" social programs like CRT and Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) are divisive as they tear at the trust and confidence our warriors must have in each other. Foreign threats are encouraged by such self-inflicted weakening of our military as the corrosive mandatory "woke" training occurs in our Services. Public trust in the military has declined in recent years, and Army recruiting is the worst since 1973 causing very dangerous reductions in force size. The defense budget does not keep up with 40 year high inflation while the IRS hires 87,000 new agents. The tenets of divisive programs like CRT and DEI, are being taught throughout our education system, corporate America, and the federal government including our military. These are Marxist techniques casting us into opposing groups based on the oppressed vs the oppressors, mostly along racial lines. The purpose is to sow seeds of distrust which often leads to civil unrest and increasing violence as seen in many large cities. The "rule of law" is lost when a double standard exists, laws are selectively enforced, mayors and DAs decide when to prosecute based on politics, preference goes to criminals over victims, the DOJ/FBI is weaponized against parents speaking at school board meetings, and now blatantly against political opponents. De-fund the police movements endanger all Americans, especially in large cities where minorities often suffer the most. Without the "rule of law" and accountability, we have lost our Republic. Other destructive actions taken by the Administration and Congress which cripple our Country include: Open borders allowing 2+ million illegals, with unknown numbers of criminals, cartel members, terrorists, drug and sex traffickers, illegal drugs, entering our Country; widely dispersed into various states; paid for at great taxpayer expense. Without Title 42, estimates are 18,000 illegals will cross our border daily totaling ~6 million more during the Biden Administration. Uncontrolled spending causing the highest inflation in 40 years. COVID lockdowns upset our work ethic by keeping people at home and giving some more money to not work than work, driving thousands of small businesses into bankruptcy making more people dependent on the government--socialism happening. * War on fossil fuels--going from energy independence to energy dependence and reaching the highest gas prices on record; asking our adversaries to bail us out and depleting our strategic petroleum reserves instead of unshackling our own massive domestic production capability. The assault on free speech and censorship coming from governmental agencies, the media, tech giants, the educational system, etc., is tyrannical. When people are afraid to say in public what they say in private, then freedom of speech is lost to cancel culture, censorship and intimidation. American citizens must stand up now for our Constitution and Rights through peaceful resistance to the Socialist/Marxist movement. A "Citizen's Action Plan for America" offers ideas for grassroots action, found at ==. Citizens must contact political representatives at the local, state, and national levels to voice support for a strong mission focused military, secure borders, election integrity, the rule of law, and against censorship and government overreach. Citizens must vote in the 2022 election for candidates who support traditional values in order to constitutionally take back control of our government. We are at a historic crossroads equal in importance to 1776. Do we hold true to our Constitutional Republic or succumb to the failed and deadly Socialist/Marxist ideology? The answer depends on citizens getting involved and acting to protect their Constitutional Rights and Liberty. National Security issues can be solved with changes to existing political policies, but that requires replacing politicians holding Socialist/Marxist ideologies with those who have the courage to defend our Constitution. Elections have huge consequences. --Signed-- MG Anders B. Aadland, USA (ret) BG John R. Allen, Jr. USAF (ret) BG Dale F. Andres, USA (ret) RADM Philip S. DOUBLE YOUR IMPACT UNTIL ELECTION DAY!

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

body:
Take a look at who’s on this team.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1181%2E61531%2EtldQrq)
There’s just five days until the midterms, and our movement continues to grow.
We’re so grateful for the broad coalition of support Peter has earned from stakeholders big and small across a wide range of issues — including grassroots supporters like you in every county in Vermont. **Take a look at who's on this team:**
**NARAL Pro-Choice America:**
“During his time in the House of Representatives, Rep. Welch has consistently advocated for reproductive freedom and fought back against restrictions on abortion access. At a time when reproductive freedom is under attack like never before, it is imperative to elect leaders like Rep. Welch to the Senate.”
**Vermont Sierra Club:**
“We are pleased to announce that the Sierra Club officially endorses Peter Welch’s election. We are confident that he will continue to work to protect Vermont families’ health, air, and water, and build a clean energy economy that works for all Vermonters.”
**Human Rights Campaign:**
“Throughout his career in Congress, Rep. Welch has been a strong and consistent supporter of LGBTQ+ equality and ensuring that the members of our community are able to live freely and fully as equal members of society. In short, Rep. Welch will be a great U.S. senator for Vermont and for the country, and HRC is proud to endorse him.”
**End Citizens United:**
“We need an anti-corruption champion like Congressman Welch in the Senate. We know that just as he’s done in the House, he will do everything he can in the Senate to stop the corrupting influence of dark money in politics and ensure Vermont families can make their voices and votes heard in our elections.”
**Sen. Elizabeth Warren:**
“I am proud to endorse my friend Congressman Peter Welch for Senate. Over the past 15 years, Peter has fought tirelessly for Vermonters in Washington and delivered results that improve the lives of America’s working families. I’m happy to support Peter’s campaign, and I look forward to continuing our important work together in the Senate.”
And it’s not just organizations and legislators, either. We asked for this grassroots coalition to endorse Peter, and thousands of you responded. Here are just a few:
**Annette S., Winooski:**
“Peter Welch has my full confidence at a time when there are so many challenges in governing our country. His honest approach to issues, his lively personality, and his exceptional ability to communicate complicated legislative policy to regular folks make him an outstanding candidate. Representative Welch is ready for a bigger stage, a bigger role in government!”
**David S., Bristol:**
“Rep. Welch has been consistent in his support for Vermont families. He recognizes the importance of addressing climate change, voting rights, health, and educational priorities. I want him to take his energy and work to our U.S. Senate.”
**Thecia C., Wallingford:**
“Peter Welch is one of the most honest, hard working, and believable men in politics. He genuinely believes in people, understands their struggles and works tirelessly to improve their lives. He has received my vote in the past, and I will continue to vote for him. He is one of the best!”
With the Senate split 50/50 and so many of our freedoms on the line, it’s clear that the stakes in this election couldn’t be any higher. That’s why we’re not stopping until the polls close on Tuesday. [**Can you help us build on this momentum and power us through the finish line with a donation right away?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4845?t=3&akid=1181%2E61531%2EtldQrq)
[DONATE ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4845?t=6&t=7&akid=1181%2E61531%2EtldQrq)
---
Thanks so much!
Welch for Vermont
**P.S.** **And of course, we couldn’t leave out your fun fact of the day! One of Peter’s strongest endorsers is his wife Margaret! They met through a conversation about school funding, and she liked that he was such a good listener. (It’s the Vermont way after all!)**

name: Hillary Clinton
subject: This race is essential to protect our Democratic majority
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
Hi friend,
I’m reaching out about the most important Senate race in the country, which could decide whether Democrats hold onto and strengthen our majority: my friend Catherine Cortez Masto’s race in Nevada.
Catherine knows a thing or two about making cracks in glass ceilings. Back in 2016, Republicans spent $50 million trying to defeat her. Pundits and pollsters counted Catherine out, predicting Nevada would flip red. But she fought her heart out and overcame it all, becoming our nation’s first and only Latina senator.
History has a way of repeating itself: Catherine once again is facing Republican attacks that media reports have called “unprecedented” – with Mitch McConnell and his allies spending more than $55 million to defeat her. Every major election forecaster – The New York Times , CNN, Nate Silver’s FiveThirtyEight – has called Catherine the most vulnerable senator on the ballot. Experts are saying Nevada is Mitch McConnell’s best hope at flipping a seat red, and he only needs to pick up one seat to take back control of the Senate.
I'm asking you to not let that happen. Catherine needs your grassroots support in these crucial, final days of the election. Will you split a donation of
Across the country, we are seeing a wave of extremist Republican candidates – handpicked and backed by Donald Trump – running to flip the Senate red. Nevada is no exception. Catherine is up against an opponent who led Donald Trump’s efforts to overturn the election results in Nevada. Her opponent also celebrated the overturning of Roe, calling the landmark law that protected reproductive freedom “a joke.”
So, friend, this election is not merely a choice between divergent political parties. It’s a choice of whether we stand with candidates like Catherine on the side of truth, progress and democracy – or whether we allow candidates loyal to Donald Trump take power and trample all over our democracy.
The choice is ours to make, but time is running short. With just five days to go, polling shows Catherine in a statistical tie with her opponent, so she urgently needs grassroots resources to mobilize voters, pull ahead and win. So please, split a contribution of
Thank you,
Hillary Clinton

body:
MUST READ | |
---

|
Peter,

I want to make my agenda clear. My top priority is flipping the State Senate but I have strong beliefs I will fight for once I get there.

**1\. CREATING JOBS AND OPPORTUNITY**
As a businesswoman, I understand the amount of obstacles small business face when it comes to government overregulation. I will fight for businesses to remain open and to get government OUT of our small businesses.

**2\. PROTECTING LIFE**
As a single mother, I understand that many women are put in very difficult situations. That is why I believe our government should not support or fund the abortion of babies. I will fight for more resources to help mothers carry their babies to term.

**3\. IMPROVING EDUCATION**
I understand the dangers of indoctrinating curriculum and I want to put a stop to it. I believe that parents deserve a say in their children’s school and curriculum, and I think our students deserve a better education. That is why I will fight for school choice and END radical curricula.

**4\. BETTER HEALTHCARE**
Both of my parents owned their own medical practices. I know how important medical providers, quality of care, and access to care are. I will fight to return healthcare choices to the patient and advocate for more access to healthcare without government input.

**5\. ENSURING OUR RELIGIOUS FREEDOM**
I believe that everyone has the right to live according to their convictions. I will fight to stop the radical left from trampling on our religious freedoms. I started my own organization to defend everyone’s religious freedom and have seen how countries flourish when they value this foundational freedom.
---
| | Thank you,

Tina Ramirez
