disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221103&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221103&amount=28]
Team,
There are just five days left until Election Day – and in one of the most competitive districts in the country, we’re making each of those five days count. Here’s an update on where we stand:
Recently, the Detroit News confirmed that there are four seats in Michigan that Republicans view as critical to flipping the House [https://www.detroitnews.com/story/news/politics/2022/08/11/these-4-michigan-races-could-decide-whether-gop-retakes-u-s-house/10264174002/] – and the new 7th district is one of them.
We’ve known since the beginning that this district was a top target. It continues to be the most expensive House race in the country with over $12 million spent on negative ads against Elissa as we head into the final five days of the campaign.
With so much at stake, we’ve been taking out all the stops. Earlier this week, Congresswoman Liz Cheney joined Elissa for an “Evening for Patriotism and Bipartisanship. A crowd of 600 joined us to discuss the moment we’re in as a country, and how engaged citizenship and principled leaders can bring us out of it.
In reaction, Elissa’s opponent rushed to get Harriet Hageman, an election denier, and Tulsi Gabbard, a Putin apologist, to endorse him. He then repeated his case to former VP Pence, who is coming in for a rally with him tomorrow.
So what are we doing with 5 days to go? Our field team is out in the new 7th district in full force. We have 8 staging locations to give our volunteers the materials they need to get out on the doors. We’ll be hosting huge events to excite voters and drive turnout. And of course, our MSU student organizers will be spending the next 5 days talking to as many students as they physically can.
We’re still expecting this to be an extremely close race, which means we’ll be working day and night for the next five days to get over the finish line – and we’re asking if you’ll help us out. Chip in below to help us continue to run TV and digital ads and connect with voters for the next five days! [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221103&amount=28]

**JAYME STEVENSON WARNS OF FRAUDULENT TEXT CAMPAIGN, ATTACK ON ELECTION**
Defamatory Text States Nominee for US Congress “Stepping Down”
---
| | FAIRFIELD, CT - Jayme Stevenson is advising voters in Southwestern Connecticut of a deceptive text campaign to “see my statement” claiming that she is “stepping down as the GOP nominee for US Congress 4 days before election day.”
---
|
---
**Jayme Stevenson is and remains a viable candidate for US Congress in Connecticut's 4th District, and will in fact be on the ballot on November 8th**.
Stevenson became aware of **the scandalous text** when a local Board of Finance member shared the message with her campaign team. In addition to stating that **the deceptive message is completely false** , Stevenson is also warning voters not to open or click through any links that may seem like a **hoax**. Official messages from Jayme Stevenson for US Congress or any other candidate are **all** obligated by law to have a campaign disclaimer.
Stevenson, the endorsed Republican and Independent nominee in the upcoming Election on November 8th stated the following, **“It is most disheartening to see that our election process remains under attack by bad actors who will stop at nothing, including breaking the law, to disrupt our democracy and deceive voters. Today’s assault on democracy only strengthens my resolve to make this a priority for the voters of our district and the American people.”****
**
---

| Peter, Election Day is just days away, and our grassroots field team is working hard to turn every one of our voters out to the polls by Tuesday to elect Kevin Mullin to Congress.

**During this final week, our biggest need is more volunteers on the doors and phones to help boost our grassroots turnout efforts.**

**Can Kevin count on you to help us get out the vote?**

We’re canvassing this Saturday, with multiple launches in all corners of the district. You can [click here](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=3217b82bb6&e=292fde286a) to sign up for a shift. 📋🚪

If you’re unable to knock doors, we’ll be running phone banks every day until Election Day from 4 to 6 p.m. We have both virtual and in-person phone banks available. You can [sign up here](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=33017acb26&e=292fde286a). ☎️📞

Our experienced grassroots field team will be there to provide a full training before every single shift.

Also, I wanted to invite you to our Election Night Watch Party at the Fernekes Building in Orange Memorial Park in South City, starting at 7 p.m. on Election Night. You won’t want to miss it. [Click here to RSVP](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=c4dbe5c9c4&e=292fde286a).

body:
I’m counting on yinz.
#
We are just *five days* out from Election Day, Derek.
Don’t mind if I get a little sentimental here, okay? 😭 **[(If you don’t have time for this trip down memory lane, mind chipping in $5, $50, or $500 to help power us through November 8?)](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221103-4?refcode=em20221103-8039&refcode2=8039_434096_k_9WHe&akid=8039%2E434096%2Ek_9WHe)**
Back when we launched this campaign in early 2021, I already knew this journey wouldn’t be easy. But I knew that together we could build a campaign that was *special* + *BIG*.
And WOW, did you all prove me right. This grassroots team has broken basically every goal we’ve set, with the help of 735,000 unique grassroots supporters, all while maintaining an average donation of just $36. Not to mention the fact that we won Every. Single. County. in the primary.
Now, let me jump forward to the present + near future. **We have what it takes to win this thing because of people like you, Derek.**
**[Can you chip in a donation of any amount today to show your support for my campaign for U.S. Senate? This campaign is for — and supported by — real working people, not dark-money Super PACs.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221103-4?amount=5&refcode=em20221103-8039&refcode2=8039_434096_k_9WHe&akid=8039%2E434096%2Ek_9WHe)**
Going back to how “this isn’t going to be easy...”
**The fight to flip this Senate seat is literally one of the most important in the country.** We’re rated as the #1 Toss-Up race by CNN, our Cook Political Report rating has gone from “toss-up” to “lean Democrat” then _back_ to “toss-up,” and we’re up against Dr. Oz, the top self-funding federal candidate in the country.
So, here’s what I know to be true:
We must expand our Senate majority.
We must end the filibuster + codify abortion rights into law.
We must defeat Dr. Oz, who would support an extreme national abortion ban (and doesn’t even live in PA, btw).
**And it all comes down to flipping this seat in just *five* days.**
**[That’s why I’m asking for your support today. It would mean the world to me if you chipped in your very first $5 today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221103-4?amount=5&refcode=em20221103-8039&refcode2=8039_434096_k_9WHe&akid=8039%2E434096%2Ek_9WHe)**
**[Contribute $5](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221103-4?amount=5&refcode=em20221103-8039&refcode2=8039_434096_k_9WHe&akid=8039%2E434096%2Ek_9WHe)**
Thank you, thank you, THANK YOU!
John ❤️
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate
P.S. The stakes couldn’t be higher + our opponent’s got virtually unlimited money to spend. **[Please chip in a donation today, if you can afford it.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221103-4?refcode=em20221103-8039&refcode2=8039_434096_k_9WHe&akid=8039%2E434096%2Ek_9WHe)** 🙏

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20221103-8039-footer&t=1&refcode2=8039_434096_k_9WHe&akid=8039%2E434096%2Ek_9WHe)**

subject: 5 more days to make a difference!
body:
We are only 5 days away from the most important midterm election of our lifetime - it is more important than ever for folks to work to Get Out the Vote and make sure that we elect Democrats representing our voice and values. So much is at stake - from voting rights to a woman’s right to choose. Can YOU take 30 minutes in the next 5 days to help turn folks out to vote? Please check out below to find ways to get involved and do your part to elect Democrats up and down the ballot on November 8th!

Here is what we ask: Go to IWillVote.com (https://iwillvote.com/) so you can make a plan to, in the words of President Biden this week, “Vote, vote, vote!”
Ways to Get Involved

A wonderful way to get involved with the DNC is to join one of our phone banking events! See details below to find a phone banking time that works for you:

Join the DNC Native Caucus and Caucus Chair Clara Pratte for virtual phone banks! We will meet on Zoom, talk about the voters we are calling, and help turn out the vote! Sign up to make calls on Saturday, November 5 at 4:00 pm MDT / 6:00 pm ET. Sign up here (https://events.democrats.org/event/537857/) .

Rep. Abigail Spanberger in VA-07 is in one of the most competitive races in the nation, and Team Spanberger needs your help to Get Out the Vote! Join folks for a final GOTV phone bank on Tuesday 11/8 by clicking here (https://www.mobilize.us/spanbergerforcongress/event/529962/) .

Calls to Action/Opportunities
* General Sign Up List for NC Phone Bank, Canvas, Text Bank or Other: Help Us Get Black People Out to Vote: https://forms.gle/gP3gdJ66pf9f5LXi7
* Social Action Saturday(Nov 5): This is a big multi-area (Greensboro, Raleigh, Greenville, Winston Salem, Charlotte and more) activity taking place on Saturday, November 5th to close out early voting. There is a special “Divine 9” Challenge to see who can get the most participation. This is a wear “your colors not your letters” activity. Use this link (https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfHJ08ATfaDg06rt3rnYbToVkB4jbOXY87nzSlt5D3XsVj6rg/viewform) to sign up for the site in your area (Flyers attached). Contact me to volunteer Kellye Jones kjones@2022victory.org (mailto:kjones@2022victory.org) 973-722-9130
* Carolyn Thompson, NC Court of Appeals Candidate is looking for people to help phone bank in Granville County. She has a list.
* You can use the Red Wine & Blue "Rally" tool to track folks you are helping to get to the polls; Text "Rally" to 59868 to download it; no PWD needed; it's connected to the voter files so you can see if/when those you are tracking have voted.
* Take Action with Blue Unity 2022: You can also sign up and share for folks to volunteer. https://www.mobilize.us/blueunityin2022/
* UNC Student Voting Day, Nov 5, 2022 FREE FOOD, MUSIC, PRIZES, AND ALL OF YOUR FAVORITE ORGANIZATIONS IN 1 PLACE! Catch us on the Bell Tower Quad to celebrate UNC Student Voting Day! Drop by any time between 10AM to 4PM to join the fun

Join the Native American Coalition for a virtual gathering to learn more about the upcoming elections and help your friends and family members make plans to vote!
Coalition Updates

In Philadelphia and Wisconsin, our LGBTQ+ Coalitions Director has worked to put on events with local drag queens to encourage folks to get out to vote and make sure we are protecting LGBTQ+ rights!

The Building Homegrown Prosperity Together campaign has been shared with hundreds of Democratic leaders in rural counties across the country. This campaign is designed to connect with rural people on shared values and to empower local people to lead the work in their communities. The effort has engaged rural county leadership in 32 states and is building a strong network to continue the work.

MULTILINGUAL HOTLINE INFORMATION - 2022

The National Voter Assistance Hotline 1-833-DEM-VOTE (1-833-336-8683) is monitored by DNC employees and volunteers to field questions pertaining to how to vote, voter registration, polling locations, voter purging, poll worker misconduct, voting machines, accessibility, and more. This midterm election cycle, the hotline is taking calls in English and Spanish and will be offering French, Mandarin, Vietnamese, and Tagalog language support starting November 1 through Election Day.

Regular Hotline hours are Monday-Friday 9 a.m. - 6 p.m. The Hotline operates on longer hours for the month before Election Day, which can be found below (all in ET):
* Now through Monday, November 7: 9 a.m. - 11 p.m. every day
* Tuesday, November 8: 6 a.m. - midnight
* Wednesday, November 9 - Tuesday, November 15: Monday-Friday 9 a.m. - 9 p.m., Saturday 9 a.m. - 6 p.m., Sunday 12 p.m. - 6 p.m.
* Post-Tuesday, November 15 (Year Round): Monday-Friday 9 a.m. - 6 p.m.

Please share this information with your communities to ensure they have the information they need to make their voices heard on November 8. Help us protect the vote by reaching as many voters as possible to expand voting access.

INFORMACIÓN SOBRE LA LÍNEA MULTILINGÜE DE PROTECCIÓN AL VOTANTE - 2022

La Línea de Protección Al Votante 1-833-DEM-VOTE (1-833-336-8683), operada por empleados y voluntarios del Partido Demócrata, se encarga de responder a una gran variedad de preguntas sobre el proceso de votación, desde cómo votar, el registro de votantes, las direcciones de los centros de votación, la purga de votantes, la mala conducta de trabajadores electorales, las máquinas de votación, hasta el acceso para las personas con discapacidad(es), y más.

Para las elecciones de medio término 2022, la Línea de Protección al Votante ya está operando en inglés y español, y en el día de las elecciones y en la semana que lo precede, estará atendiendo a los votantes multilingües en tagalo, vietnamita, mandarín, y francés también.

Para el mes antes del día de las elecciones, la Línea de Protección al Votante tendrá horas extendidas de operación:
* A partir de ahora hasta el lunes, 7 de noviembre: 9 a.m. - 11 p.m. (ET: hora del este) todos los días
* El martes, 8 de noviembre: 6 a.m. - medianoche ET
* El miércoles, 9 de noviembre - martes 15 de noviembre:
+ Lunes-viernes: 9 a.m. - 9 p.m. ET
+ Sábado: 9 a.m. - 6 p.m. ET
+ Domingo: 12 p.m. - 6 p.m. ET

Por favor, no dude en compartir esta información con sus comunidades para ayudarles a hacer escuchar su voz el 8 de noviembre. Ayúdenos a amplificar este mensaje y hacerlo llegar a tantos votantes como sea posible. ¡Juntos podemos proteger el voto y aumentar el acceso a la votación!

clean_body: | | | This is 10 years in the making. | | | Team, As Election Day sneaks closer and closer, I want to look back at how far Arizona has come in the past decade. In 2012, Democrats were in a super-minority in the House and Senate. Our then State Senator Katie Hobbs and House Minority Leader Dr. Eric Meyer knew if we were going to make progress in Arizona, there needed to be a dedicated movement to flip both chambers. That’s when they created the ADLCC. Ten years later, we are now just one seat away from tying each chamber. We have worked for years to get within striking distance of a Democratic majority in the legislature. This. Is. Our. Moment. We’ve proven that investing in Arizona’s legislative races produces tangible results. We work in some of the most competitive districts in the state and our record speaks for itself. Now, with so much on the line – from reproductive rights to education funding – we need all hands on deck to finally flip AZ blue. | **Least Regulated State Claim - Complicit Leader or Asleep at the Wheel? Pick One**As the Gem State Patriot [revealed](https://gemstatepatriot.com/blog/did-brad-little-really-cut-regulations/), Brad Little's Executive Order to Cut Red Tape set the wheels in motion to game the system and achieve the Least Regulated State title from the Mercatus Center. The Division of Financial Management empowered the 180 Agencies by telling them how to do it in their [Agency Guide](https://dfm.idaho.gov/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Prospective-Analysis-Guide-May-2020.pdf), which specified the 5 words to eliminate to achieve the coveted title. Many suspected this was happening, but the hard data from Mercatus wasn't available until now. Over 8000 examples can now be found on the [Least Regulated State](https://leastregulatedstate.com/) website.There is no longer any doubt about what happened. The only question remains whether Brad Little was complicit or asleep at the wheel. A Governor needs to be a leader. They're the CEO of the state, not a figurehead. CEO's delegate, but after they present their vision in an executive order, they are the most important check and balance. They must provide hands-on oversight. They must ask the most basic questions to ensure they don't embarrass the people of Idaho by meeting with the President and Vice President and proclaiming that Idaho is "providing a template for other states and the federal government to follow" with simple word substitutions to game the system. If this glaring lack of oversight happened with red tape, we can only wonder what's happened with the management of our state's finances. As Governor, I will be that CEO that answers to you, the shareholders of the state of Idaho, and provides the leadership, vision, and oversight that our great state deserves.
Sincerely,Ammon Bundy

This will be an opportunity for you to ask me questions about the Keep Idaho IDAHO plan or anything else for the last time before the election. As Governor, I will be that CEO that answers to you, the shareholders of the state of Idaho, and provides the leadership, vision, and oversight that our great state deserves. Sincerely,Ammon Bundy P.S. The Virtual Q&A will be held on Monday (7th) at 7PM MST.
